notes.content:
Server maintenance planned date and time
From 8/5/2025 (Tue) 4:00 PM (PDT) to 8/6/2025 (Wed) 1:00 AM (PDT)
[previewyoutube=NZImkylMAYA;full][/previewyoutube][August Update Info]System updates
Class Skill adjustments
Fighter adjustments
Class Skill adjustments
The following adjustments will be made to Fighter Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Defeat Advantage[/td][td]Increased Down Potency when used with Main Class.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload Short Cycle[/td][td]Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload After PP Preservation[/td][td]Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fighter Arts Pursuit[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Attack Impact[/td][td]Increased shockwave Potency.
Increased shockwave velocity.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Deadly Archer[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Expanded the attack range.
Changed specifications so that the distance retreated after attacking can be reduced by inputting forward.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Spiral Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Changed specifications so that the distance retreated after attacking can be reduced by inputting forward.
Adjusted to allow movement after attacking when inputting left or right while locked on.[/td][/tr][/table]
Twin Daggers adjustments
Added an omni-directional guard point to the 4th step of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack.Changed specifications for the 4th step of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack so that when attacking mid-air with an enemy within a certain distance, the height of ascent will adjust to the target's height.Increased Potency of Twin Daggers Photon Blast.Increased the approach distance and speed of Twin Daggers Photon Blast when activated while a target is present.Relaxed the vertical approach angle for Twin Daggers Photon Blast.Changed specifications of Twin Daggers Photon Blast so that when attacking on the ground, the character will chase the target into the air.Adjusted Twin Daggers Photon Blast to allow movement while the attack is active.The following adjustments will be made to Twin Daggers Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Circling Buzzard[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Expanded the attack range of the second half of the attack.
Adjusted the forward guard point of the second half of the attack to be omni-directional and extended.
Eased Hit Stops when attacked by enemies during the second half of the attack.
Adjusted to make the character face the target if no direction is inputted while the second half of the attack is active.
Relaxed the turning timing of the final attack in the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
 Double Saber adjustments
The following adjustments will be made to Double Saber Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Julien Dance[/td][td]Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the turn timing of the final attack in the second half.
Added a forward guard point for the final attack in the second half. [/td][/tr][/table]
 Knuckles adjustments
Adjusted Knuckles Weapon Action so that players are not moved too close to enemies when attacking on the ground.The following adjustments will be made to Knuckles Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Swift Rush[/td][td]Adjusted to allow movement when inputting left or right while locked on or in Over-the-Shoulder View during activation of the first half of the attack.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Thousand Blows[/td][td]Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed Sidestep cancel timing in the first half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Double Drive[/td][td]Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the jump cancel timing in the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
Gunner balance adjustments
Class Skill adjustments
The following adjustments will be made to Gunner Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger[/td][td]Changed the specifications to increase the Down Factor of Chain Finisher Boost according to the Chain Number.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger Increase[/td][td]Changed the specifications to increase the Down Factor of Chain Finisher Boost according to the Chain Number.
Increased the increase per Chain.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Boost[/td][td]Changed specifications so that if a special armament is equipped while Chain Boost is active, the Attack Speed Up level and remaining effect duration are restored to their previous values upon unequipping the armament.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger Count Retain[/td][td]Increased the Chain Number of the next activated Chain Trigger when a Chain Trigger ends without a Chain Finisher Boost.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stylish Onslaught[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased charge amount of Hail of Bullets gauge.
Expanded the attack range.
Increased movement distance when the enemy is within a certain distance.
Changed specifications to activate invulnerability when nullifying an attack.
Changed specifications to activate the effects of the following Class Skills when nullifying an attack.
EChain Boost AdvancedEStylish Roll Counter BulletEStylish Roll Strike BackEStrikeback Advanced[/td][/tr][tr][td]Strikeback Advanced[/td][td]Extended the Invulnerability Duration at start of PA charge.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stylish Roll Counter Bullet[/td][td]Increased hit count and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][/table]
Twin Machine Guns balance adjustments
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Machine Guns Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Aimless Rain[/td][td]Adjusted specifications so that there is no forward movement during an attack but to instead move in the direction of input.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Point Blank[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased movement distance when a target is present while locked on or in Over-the-Shoulder View.
Increased movement speed when inputting movement during the attack.
Adjusted to prevent moving too close to the enemy when inputting movement during an attack.[/td][/tr][/table]
Waker adjustments
Class Skill adjustments
The following adjustments will be made to Waker Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Familiar Support[/td][td]Expanded enemy search range.
Improved homing ability.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marmelo Strike[/td][td]Increased Stage 2 Potency when successfully nullifying an attack.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marmelo Strike Tracing[/td][td]Improved homing ability.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hot Marmelo Parry[/td][td]Reduced cooldown time.[/td][/tr][/table]
Harmonizer adjustments
Increased the turning speed during activation of steps 1 to 3 of the Harmonizer Normal Attack.Increased the turning speed during activation of the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.Made the Weapon Action cancel timing more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.Made the Sidestep Action cancel timing more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.Added an omni-direction guard point to the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down. Added launch and knockback resistance to the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.Increased animation speed of the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.Made the input buffer window more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.The following adjustments will be made to Harmonizer Photon Arts
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Fredran Breath[/td][td]Increased maximum lock-ons for the follow-up attack.
Increased turning speed during activation of the follow-up attack.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fredran Riding[/td][td]Eased the firing angle of the attack when the button is not held down.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wulfen Demolition[/td][td]Increased the turning speed during activation of the second half of the attack performed when the button is not held down.
Increased turning speed during activation of the stage 1 charged attack.
Increased turning speed during activation of the stage 2 charged attack.[/td][/tr][/table]
Tech Arts Customization adjustments
Twin Machine Guns balance adjustments
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Machine Guns Tech Arts Customization.
[table][tr][th]Technique[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Aimless Rain[/td][td]Adjusted Type 1 to always maximize Potency Increase based on the distance.[/td][/tr][/table]
PAGE TOP
[hr][/hr]Enemies
The hit detection for the arms of the following enemies has been adjusted.Fortos LaserFortos LauncherVal ZaggaAn HP gauge will now be displayed for boss enemies.Some parts of the boss enemy Malignant Dark Falz Vael will now be displayed on the radar map.For the boss enemies Crocodylis and Crocodylis Vera, Throw Actions that hit while the enemy is reacting will now be counted in the number of hits.Quests and Fields
Changed specifications for the Quest Info reward display and Quest Reward Details so that if the 1st Clear Reward has already been obtained, its display priority will be lowered.Changed specifications for the Incapacitation Menu of certain quests so that the Retire from Quest option will now be available when playing solo.From the end of maintenance on 8/6/2025 (Wed) (PDT) until the start of maintenance on 9/2/2025 (Tue) (PDT), all Urgent Quests occurring in the Stia Region will be changed to the Urgent Quest: And the Stars Fell D.2.
*During this period, no other Urgent Quests will occur in the Stia Region. Please note that it will also not be possible to earn Titles related to other Urgent Quests in the Stia Region.Interface
Changed the number of digits available for inputting Battle Power and Level Restrictions in the Recruitment Settings Menu under Recruit Party Members.For the DPS display, the numbers will now be left-aligned, and the maximum number of digits that can be displayed has been increased.The following changes have been made to the Victory Performance Settings and Select Emote section of the Lookbook. The Emote currently selected under the cursor will now be played in the preview.If a button corresponding to a different Emote is pressed, it will be shown in the preview.In the Limited-Time tab of the Task List, the Campaign/Contents category has been split into Campaign and Contents, with Campaign being prioritized in the display.A Recommended tab has been added to the Task List.
The Recommended tab will display Tasks from the Campaign category of the Limited-Time tab.
*If there are no ongoing Campaign Tasks, nothing will be displayed.The window displayed for Select Emote under the Register Looks section of the Lookbook has been updated.An LG1 Rarity option has been added to the Auto Sell Drop Items settings.Leave Party has been added as a Customize Quick Menu option.The item name will now be displayed in the second tab of the weapon item details under the Multi-weapon section.Character Creation
Changed the specifications of the Salon so that the Log Window display and chat sending features are now available.The display method for some messages in the Salon has been changed.Items
Added the following items to the product list in the Exchange Shop: ARKS Record Badge Exchange.* Trunkul Almati* Revita Almati* Revolcoat Almati* Alcinq AlmatiThe 13-star Rarity Volgen weapon series has been added to the product list of the Exchange Shop under Equipment Upgrade II (Augment Transfer).Added new items to the Product List of the Exchange Shop under Purchase Build Parts.The Exchange Shop: SG Legacy Coordination Exchange has been renamed the Legacy Item Exchange.The item detail descriptions for the following items have been changed: SG Legacy Coordination Badge (Hair)SG Legacy Coordination Badge (Pose)Some items from the Super Origin Festival '25 SP Scratch lineup have been added to the Special Scratch.Added new items to the Card Scratch Ticket lineup.Changed the specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items are now available for exchange as Target Count Bonus Items: MTN: Glide - Handy Propeller EXMTN: Dash - Handy Propeller EXMTN: Dash - Magic Incantation EXMTN: Idle - Magic Incantation EXMTN: Move - Giant EXMTN: Dash - Giant EXMTN: Dash - Lancer EXMTN: Idle - Lancer EXThe icons for the following items have been changed.C/Astrio SC/EndymioC/Hi Perio IIC/Enhancement EXP +500,000
*The content and effects of these items remain unchanged.Other specification changes
Added a new starter pack to the AC Shop containing a set of 15 Line Strike cards.
Cards included in starter packs can also be won from Card Scratch Tickets.
*Please note that the cards included in the starter pack are not automatically registered to your deck, so you will need to register them by using the cards obtained after purchasing the set.Added a support effect visual in Line Strike on the battle opponent’s side to clearly indicate when an opponent’s card has had its Attack power enhanced by the Vanguard Unit skill after being Overwritten.
During spectating and replays, this support effect visual will appear regardless of faction.Added an auto-focus feature for Line Strike spectating and replays to automatically switch the Card Details display according to the state of the match.Added a feature in Line Strike to display the Card List of your current deck during a match.
*Assigned by default to the X key on the keyboard or to appear while pressing down the left stick on the controller.Added card sleeves, play mats, and cards originally released on 6/4/2025 (Wed) (PDT) to NPC Victoria's Line Strike Card Recycle.In Line Strike, the English translation of the card title unlocked by CA: Wind 2 - Lumia and CA: Wind 2R - Lumia has been changed from "Heroic Sister" to "hero's sister" to better reflect the nuance of the original character.
Accordingly, the card "World's Fastest Hedgehog" will also reference the same card as Hero's Sister - Lumia instead of Heroic Sister - Lumia in English.Added a feature to let players toggle the "Look at the camera" option in Easy Photo Mode.Added more selectable Emotes to the Victory Performance Settings.A function to control the camera during skit playback has been added when accessing certain NPCs that appear after the Main Task: A Promise to Garoa.
*For controllers: The camera can be operated using the R stick.
*For keyboard & mouse: After clicking to advance the dialogue, you can drag before the next line appears to control the camera.Bug fixes
Bugs to be fixed in NGS
Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Malignant Dark Falz Vael where the enemy's down gauge was enabled while not downedFixed a bug in Leciel Exploration: Leciel Combat Analysis Zone Survey where the object Tendal would disappear without exploding or dealing damage to surrounding enemies when destroyedFixed a bug in Leciel Combat Analysis Zone Survey where the Trial Information would sometimes not display correctlyFixed a bug with Quest Reward Details where under certain conditions, the reward type would not display in the correct orderFixed a bug where under certain conditions when opening Quest Reward Details from the world map, the window would be hidden behind the mapFixed a bug with Quest Reward Details where Featured Item Drops did not display correctly for quests with ranksFixed a bug with the Quest Reward Details where under certain conditions you could not click into the next tab while on the details windowFixed a bug where menu items that were not originally available could be selected in some quests
*As a result, the Join Party function will no longer be available from party recruitment.Fixed a bug that caused the map in the upper left corner of the screen to overlap with the Photo Room display after using the Photo Room in certain questsFixed a bug in Creative and Alliance Spaces where some item icons were not displayed at times when purchasing Build Parts with SGFixed a bug with the Braver Class Skill: After Combat PA Extension where under certain conditions the effect of increased gauge charge for Photon Bow Attack Impact was not applied when using a Multi-weaponFixed a bug that caused the game to force close under certain conditions in ShopsFixed a bug with Wired Lances and Double Sabers where some graphics were not displaying correctly for the following weaponsCinquem SeriesWeapon Camo: * Cinquem AlmatiFixed a bug where certain Title Tasks that had already ended would sometimes be displayed againFixed a bug on the PS4 and Xbox versions where the cursor would move to the top of the list when selecting Creation Data in Character Creation or the SalonFixed a bug where the Task List may not display correctly when talking to the NPCs Leah May or TimFixed a bug where the reward names for certain Tasks were not displayed in the Task List.Fixed a bug with the Wanted Item List where under certain conditions the cursor position was not saved while logged inFixed a bug with the Task List where under certain conditions the number of accepted Side Tasks was not displayedFixed a bug in the Look Breakdown of other players that prevented registering Makeup Pattern Slot 2 as a favoriteFixed a bug in the log window that caused the game to force close under certain conditionsFixed a bug with the item Progrevance where the English description would not display correctlyBugs to be fixed in NGS and PSO2

Adjusted movement performance.
Changed specifications so that movement speed changes depending on the distance from the enemy.
If the enemy is within a certain distance, falling is relaxed.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Partisan Quick Assault[/td][td]Changed specifications so that PP is not consumed when activated.[/td][/tr][/table]
Sword adjustments
Adjusted attack effects.Increased animation speed for the 4th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Added a forward guard point for the 4th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Increased movement distance for the 4th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing for the 4th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Increased Potency for the 5th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Increased PP Recovery Amount for the 5th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Expanded the attack range for the 5th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Added omni-directional guard points for the 5th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing for the 5th step of the Sword Normal Attack.Changed the specifications of the Sword's Weapon Action so that it can guard against enemy attacks in all directions.The following adjustments will be made to Sword Photon Arts.

Relaxed the timing for accepting early input while charged.

Relaxed the jump cancel timing while charged.
Relaxed Weapon Action cancel timing.

Relaxed fall timing when activated on the ground.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Calibur Streak[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Added protection from being launched or knocked back during an attack when charged.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing.
Relaxed the jump cancel timing for the 1st and 2nd steps.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Relentless Cleave[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased the rotation speed upon activation.
Changed the specifications so that it does not have an aerial status when on the ground after an attack and not charged.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing.[/td][/tr][/table]

Adjusted attack effects.Increased Potency for the 4th step of the Wired Lance Normal Attack.Increased Potency for the Wired Lance Weapon Action.Increased PP Recovery Amount for the Wired Lance Weapon Action when not moving.Increased animation speed during forward movement for the Wired Lance Weapon Action.Increased movement speed during forward movement for the Wired Lance Weapon Action.Added omni-directional guard points for the Wired Lance Weapon Action when performing the left or right variation and holding the button.Added protection from being launched or knocked back to the final stage of the attack for the Wired Lance Weapon Action when performing the left or right variation and holding the button.The following adjustments will be made to Wired Lance Photon Arts.

Relaxed the timing for accepting early input.
Relaxed the first attack cancel timing.
Relaxed the jump cancel timing.
Relaxed fall timing.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Vane Mixture[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Turbulent Train[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Decreased PP Cost.
Changed the specifications so that it does not have an aerial status when on the ground after an attack and not moving.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hellish Fall[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased movement speed and distance when charged.[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: 6/19 End of scheduled maintenance announcement
notes.content:
The scheduled maintenance that started on 6/18/2024 (Tue)  at 7:00 PM (PDT) ended on 6/19/2024 (Wed) at 1:00 AM (PDT).
The version number on the bottom right of the screen is now Ver.7.2701.1.

We have confirmed a phenomenon with the Microsoft Store version patch release from the scheduled maintenance on 

 in which a download of around 41.2 GB, which is larger than the normal patch size, is occurring.
We have confirmed that the total size of the game after downloading this patch is no different from the size on other platforms and that the game runs without problems.

Please see the following link for more details on this update.

6/19 Update details

Confirmed issuesA bug where some graphics for the Baseware C.C.'s Clothes [Ba] and its color variations are not displayed correctly under certain conditionsA bug where some graphics are not displayed correctly for the following Fullsetwear:Fighting Panda/C [Fu]Combat Panda/C [Fu]A bug where the sound effects and voices for Stamps are not audible the first time they are played after logging in
We are working to fix the above issue in a future update.
We apologize for the inconvenience and ask for your patience as we work to correct this bug.
Bug fixes
Issues fixed in NGS
Fixed a bug in Chapter 7 of the Main Story where the background music sometimes did not play correctlyFixed a bug where the description above the Material Item selection screen for EX Augment Transfer in the Item Lab stated that all Augments from all Material Items would be consumed.
*We have confirmed that this was a display-only bug and that only EX Augments were consumed.　Addressed a bug in the PS4 version where the game could crash under certain conditions when replaying events from Chapter 7 of the Main StoryFixed a bug where some EX Augments had incorrect description textFixed some typos
Maintenance Details
Things addressed during maintenance
Along with the scheduled maintenance, the expiration of Premium Sets, Extended Storage 1-7, Material Storage, Personal Shop usage, Mission Pass Storage, PSO2 Personal Quarters usage, Max Orders Received Limit Expansion, and Bonus Keys will be extended by 6 hours.
*The expiration for the above items expiring before the end of this scheduled maintenance has been extended by 6 hours from the original expiration.Characters that completed the application for Ship Transfer before the beginning of the scheduled maintenance have been transferred.
*Ship transfers during scheduled maintenance are processed in the order that they are received. There is a limit to the number of transfers that can be performed during each maintenance, and if the maximum number of applications is reached, applications will be rolled over to the next scheduled maintenance.*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check here.When logging into PSO2 Blocks, each character’s location will be set to the Gate Area.
*Characters may be moved to the Bridge depending on their progress in the story or if it is the first time the character is being used.

[June Update Info]

System updates
Fighter adjustments
Class Skill adjustments
The following adjustments will be made to Fighter Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Overload[/td][td]Relaxed the Damage Taken Rate.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload Short Cycle[/td][td]Relaxed the Damage Taken Rate.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Defeat Advantage[/td][td]Change the specifications so that the effect is also applied to Downs other than Physical and Elemental Downs.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Defeat PP Recovery[/td][td]Change the specifications so that the effect is also applied to Downs other than Physical and Elemental Downs.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Attack Impact[/td][td]Adjusted to make it easier to attack the enemy’s Weak Points.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Acceleration Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Adjusted so movement will start immediately when activated on the ground.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Twin Daggers Quick Attack[/td][td]Change the specifications so that it can also be activated with Dagger Spin Counter.
Increased movement speed and distance when a target is present and not locked onto.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Spin Counter[/td][td]Increased movement distance.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Hitcount Up PP Gain[/td][td]Increased PP Recovery Amount.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Spiral Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Changed specifications to allow movement in both vertical directions when activated while locked-on or in Over-the-Shoulder View, with a target present.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Saber Wind Amplify[/td][td]Increased the Charge Rate and Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Knuckle Attack Alternation[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][/table]
 Twin Daggers adjustments
Adjusted attack effects.Increased Potency in the 3rd to 4th steps of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack.
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Daggers Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Circling Buzzard[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Helzeus Coat[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased the motion speed after the attack cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Pirouette Ripper[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Limber Figure[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Added omnidirectional guard points to the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
 Double Saber adjustments
Adjusted attack effects.Adjusted the timing of whirlwind generation during the Double Saber Photon Blast.Increased the Charge amount for whirlwinds during the Double Saber Photon Blast.
The following adjustments will be made to Double Saber Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Julien Dance[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased the rotation speed when the first half is activated.
Increased the movement speed in the first half when activated with a target present.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Unchained Circle[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Quick Gash[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sky Climb[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
 Knuckles adjustments
Adjusted attack effects.Increased the Potency of the 4th to 5th steps of the Knuckles Normal Attack.
The following adjustments will be made to Knuckles Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Swift Rush[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased the motion speed after the attack cancel timing in the first half.
Changed specifications to allow downward movement when the first half is activated in a locked-on or Over-the-Shoulder View with a target present.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Thousand Blows[/td][td]Adjusted Potency distribution.
Expanded the attack range of some of the attacks in the second half.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.
Relaxed the attack cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Specifications changed to reduce the amount of altitude gained when activated in mid-air with no enemies nearby.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Double Drive[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Backhand Strike[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Adjustments made to increase the movement distance in the second half when activated from the first half.
Added omni-directional guard points to the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
Players
The Potency of special armaments will be adjusted if the player’s Battle Power is 3900 or higher.
Enemies
Regular enemies of the same level as the Dread Enemies in the Stia Region will no longer spawn around them.
Quests and Fields
The area where enemies appear during PSE Bursts has been narrowed in all Combat Sectors.
*Excluding Combat Sectors where this area was already narrow.After using a green jump pad, such as those found in Field Races, players' characters will now transition into a Dash Motion when landing on the ground while inputting a directional command.The spawn locations of some Dread Enemies in West Kvaris and Central Kvaris have been changed.In the following quests, quantities have been increased for some drop items:Duel: Phase 1-1Duel: Phase 1-2Duel: Phase 1-3Duel: Phase 1-4Duel: Phase 2Duel: Phase 3Duel: Phase 4
Interface
Updated Item Details so that the page last opened for items in a category is remembered until you exit the game.Added a setting for Vital Gauge Designs to toggle the display of the HP/PP gauges.Added the following menu items to the Quick Menu for Line Strike:Line Strike Ranked BattleLine Strike Unranked Battle*These menu items will not be available for use until Line Strike is released in a later update.Added backdrops to Edit ARKS ID that can be unlocked with Title Points.Added a With Augments item to the settings for Auto Sell Drop Items.Within Auto Sell Drop Items, if items are selected under Items That Can be Auto Sold, those items will now be sold automatically without regard to the Rarity levels, etc., selected in the options.Rarity of 11 or higher has been added to Rarity Settings for Item Drop Animations: Weapons/Armor.Changed specifications for Standard Sort under the Misc. tab of the Inventory so that items with expiration dates are displayed first in order to prevent them from being forgotten.Changed specifications so that the message is displayed when selecting a new notification for a new friend request, Alliance scouting, or mail during all All-ship Matchmaking.Added Premium slots 31 to 50 for Looks.Changed specifications for the Salon so that when the Advanced Settings of an accessory are restored to the default, the color of the accessory will be the color that the accessory has when it is worn.A new category, Line Strike, has been added to the Communication section of the Main Menu.
*Line Strike is not currently playable. Please wait for a separate announcement on the start date.Added an Augment Transfer menu option in the Item Lab.
*See here for details.
0Creative Space
Changed specifications for Premium and Rental Creative Spaces so that users can enter even after the Space’s expiration date.*Players can only make edits while the Premium/Rental Creative Space is active.Rental C-Space 04 has been added to Creative Space.Changes have been made so that it is easier to register Built Parts in succession.Changed specifications for Creative Space so that the reflection of light off of Built Parts appears more natural.
*Brightness and color tones indoors may change as a result of this specification change.
Items
Changed specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items will be available for exchange as Target Count Bonus Items:MTN: Glide - Leg Wheels EXMTN: Dash - Leg Wheels EXMTN: Glide - Graceful EXMTN: Dash - Graceful EXMTN: Glide - Dark Mage EXMTN: Dash - Dark Mage EXMTN: Glide - Star Riding EXMTN: Dash - Star Riding EXChanged specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items will be available for exchange as Target SG Scratch Items:C/Highret Domina SC/Highkvar Domina SAdded N-Augment Transfer Pass to the Product List in Item Recycle.A portion of the Spring '24 Special Scratch lineup has been added to the Special Scratch lineup.The following new items have been added to the Exchange Shop: ARKS Record Badge Exchange:* Millenium Round Almati CV* Greaga Almati CV* Codeck Almati CV* Crystia Almati CVThe following items have been added to the product list of the Exchange Shop: Giga Strugment Exchange:C/Defi Eriss P.04C/Defi Ceires P.04C/Defi Plutos P.04C/Defi Makemes P.04C/Defi Haumeas P.04C/Defi Sednas P.04
Other specification changes
Specifications have been changed so that Towers and Cocoons are changed to Discovered as each chapter of the Main Story is completed.A new Main Story will be released.
When you start the new storyline, releasing on 6/5/2024(Wed) 01:00 AM (PDT), any Mini Episodes that have not been viewed in Chapter 6 will have their status changed to viewed.
This is the perfect time to complete all the Mini Episodes if you haven’t already, so you can enjoy the new storyline even more.
*Unwatched Mini Episodes that have their status set as viewed will still be accessible from the Quest Counter.
*If you use an NGS Story Progress Ticket and start from Chapter 7 without having progressed through Chapter 6, the Side Tasks for Side Stories will be set as completed. Quest Rewards for Side Stories that have changed from uncompleted to completed can be earned by accepting orders from the Quest Counter and completing them.

We are working to fix the above issues in a future update.

[hr][/hr]Maintenance details
Things addressed during maintenance
Along with the scheduled maintenance, the expiration of Premium Sets, Extended Storage 1-7, Material Storage, Personal Shop usage, Mission Pass Storage, PSO2 Personal Quarters usage, Max Orders Received Limit Expansion, and Bonus Keys will be extended by 6 hours.
*The expiration for the above items expiring before the end of this scheduled maintenance has been extended by 6 hours from the original expiration.
Characters that completed the application for Ship Transfer before the beginning of the scheduled maintenance have been transferred.

Please check the official website page for more information.
https://pso2.com/players/news/i_maintenance_20240529/

*You can obtain delivered items via the Receive Campaign Items option on the Visiphone in PSO2 Blocks or Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Items are distributed to the account, so please be mindful of which character you use to receive them.
*You will not be able to receive items if you do not have enough space in your inventory or if additional items would exceed your maximum carrying capacity.


Thank you for playing PSO2 New Genesis!

*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.

*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them..

[hr][/hr]The ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day!

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]  [tr]    [th]                             ARKS Rappy[/th]    [th]                          Rappy Suit Mini[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg[/td]    [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg[/td]  [/tr][/table]

In PSO2 Blocks on the 1st and 21st of every month – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the ARKS Rappy will appear! They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!
They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS!

*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.

[hr][/hr]Precautions
Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
Only users using a Premium Set during the campaign period are eligible.
The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.
Thank you for enjoying PSO2:NGS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f8f6cf6a48482ff8a4b109601e025bfc9b2535e4.jpg

Thank you for playing PSO2 NEW GENESIS ver.2.

The date and time for the scheduled maintenance on 7/18 (Tue) (PDT) will be changed as follows:

7/18 (Tue) 6:00 PM (PDT) to 7/19 (Wed) 1:00 AM (PDT)

Please also be aware that along with the time change for the scheduled maintenance on 7/18 (Tue) (PDT), distributed items with a receipt period that is until the start of scheduled maintenance must be received by 7/18 (Tue) 6:00 PM (PDT).

Please note that the scheduled maintenance end time may change depending on the circumstances.

The latest update patch is scheduled to be released on 7/18 (Tue) at 7:00 PM (PDT).

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding.

[hr][/hr]*Please do not connect to the game servers until the end of maintenance is announced.

*Please note that the availability of Weekly Tasks and Limited-time Tasks that end at 8:00 PM (PDT) on the day of scheduled maintenance will end at the start of scheduled maintenance.

*Please note that if the 24 hour period after a Character Deletion Request passes during the maintenance, the character will be deleted.

*Characters that have completed the “Application for Ship Transfer During Scheduled Maintenance” will be transferred. AC will not be consumed until the Ship Transfer is complete.

*Ship Transfer applications will be processed according to the order in which they were submitted. However, some Ship Transfers may be postponed until the next Scheduled Maintenance if the number of submitted applications is excessive.

*If you do not have enough AC at the beginning of the Scheduled Maintenance, Ship Transfer will not occur, even if you purchase AC during the Scheduled Maintenance.

*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check here.

Thank you for enjoying PSO2:NGS Ver.2!

A bug with Display Settings Related to Event Submission in the Main Menu in NGS Blocks where, when moving to the Creative Space or to a Block in another region, Submittable is displayed regardless of your Look Breakdown
*This bug can be fixed by changing the items in your Look Breakdown.
A bug with Toggle Play Navigator Display for the World Map where Ryuker Devices, etc. sometimes cannot be selected
*We have confirmed that if this bug occurs, it can be resolved by reopening the World Map.

A bug with the Creative Space where if Return to Starting Point is selected under certain conditions the game may crash

*The options Return to Starting Point and Return to ARKS base will appear when you access the Initial Teleporter in the Creative space under Communications in the Main Menu.

notes.title: Advanced notice of the release of paid Level and Story Boost features
notes.content:
We are planning to provide paid features in the update on 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT) that enable players to raise their class levels or advance their Story Progress instantly.


The purpose of these features is to support those who are just starting or returning to the game and want to catch up to and socialize with other players as well as access new content.
Moreover, we believe it will also help players who wish to level additional characters progress though the Main Story in a more efficient manner.

See below for preliminary introductions to each new feature.

[hr][/hr]NGS Story Progress Tickets
This item can be used to skip through the Main Story to the latest chapter at the time of use.
The selected Main Class at the time of item use will get the EXP needed to reach the recommended class level to play the latest chapter.
Purchase limit: none
[hr][/hr]Class Level 70 & Equipment Set
This item raises the selected Main Class level to 70 and provides one weapon from each weapon category available to the selected class as well as 3 pieces of armor.
Equipment items will be set to increase the character’s Battle Power to the amount they need to play the latest content as of 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT).
Purchase limit: 1 for each class on each character.
Items will be delivered to the OP Team Storage.
[hr][/hr]NGS Ver.1 All Trainia Explored
This item sets the status of all Cocoons and Towers available as of 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT) to “completed” so that players can acquire the Skill Points from the first clear reward.
If there are Cocoons or Towers you’ve already completed, you will not receive the first clear reward Skill Points again.
Purchase limit: 1 per account.
[hr][/hr]
We will provide further details at a later date.

Thank you for enjoying PSO2 NEW GENESIS.

notes.title: Game Data for PSO2 to be released as free DLC on 6/7
notes.content:
Following the update on 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT), we plan to release the data for PSO2 as a separate DLC (free of charge) for Xbox One, the MS Store, Steam, and the Epic Games Store versions of NGS.

[hr][/hr]
The data for PSO2 will no longer be included in the main data download for NGS after this update. Those who wish to play in PSO2 Blocks or play certain Music Discs that require data from PSO2, please download the PSO2 DLC from your respective platform's store.

*This also applies to players who had been playing NGS prior to the update on 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT).
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and ask for your understanding.

Thank you for playing PSO2 NEW GENESIS.

This information is also available on our Official Website

[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Issues fixed in NGS
[expand type=details]
Fixed an intermittent bug with the Hunter Class Skill Wired Anchor Advanced where, under certain conditions, the effect was not applied
Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, the effect of the Fighter Class Skill Overload could be applied to attacks of non-Fighter weapon types

Fixed a bug where the sound effects were not played when a Hydrome was made an ally
Fixed an intermittent bug where, under certain conditions, the special equipment Floating Boards could not be deactivated when a Room Keyword was set
Fixed an intermittent bug with the large enemy cameras where, under certain conditions, the camera would not behave correctly when switching between cameras
Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Nils Vera where, after a part of it was destroyed, players would still be target locked on the destroyed section
Fixed an intermittent bug where the boss enemies Renus Retem and Renus Vera wouldn’t reappear at the correct time after burrowing into the ground
Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Quartz Skodin that caused some attacks to have large reactions when they hit
Fixed an intermittent bug with the boss enemy Nex Vera where, when angered, it would perform the action of boss enemy Nex Aelio
Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Dark Falz where the enemy’s graphics were not displayed correctly under certain conditions

Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Nils Vera where a Hit Stop would occur when hitting certain parts of its body

Fixed a bug where Dread Enemies were not displayed correctly in West Kvaris and South Kvaris
*The positions of Veteran Frostyl Sword and Veteran Pangolan will change as a result of this fix.
Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, some enemies would move to areas inaccessible to players
Fixed an intermittent bug in the Maqead Lower Level Combat Sector where enemies would not appear during a PSE Climax and it would become impossible to progress
Fixed an intermittent bug in the Lost Central Combat Sector where Enormous Icicles did not deal damage to enemies
Fixed a bug with the Gathering Item Famous Stia Crab where the animation did not play correctly
Fixed an intermittent bug where the sound effects for Frozen Item Containers, Cold Photons, Complex Minerals, and Lava Cores did not play correctly
Fixed a bug where the color of a Color Variant Weapon was applied to the effect for picking up Lava Bombs
Fixed a bug where some Score Symbols overlapped in the Field Races South Retem Dash (Stage 1) and Dreisen Plant Board (Stage 1)
Fixed an intermittent bug where Lava Cores did not explode properly when hit with Lava Bombs
Fixed a bug with the Transport Truck Defense Trials where the Transport Truck HP bar was not displayed correctly
Fixed a bug with Relentless Training Across Halpha 2-X where the Task would progress even if the enemy defeated was at a level other than the target level
Fixed a bug in the Salon where characters would appear dark during Live Concerts

notes.title: New Year's greeting, 2023
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d05c06a8d98b448fbd2e21d7dea5b08361c2a7a0.jpg
Happy New Year!

Thank you very much for enjoying PSO2 and PSO2 NEW GENESIS (NGS) during the past year.
Please allow us to offer our deepest appreciation.

The year 2022 was a memorable year that marked the first anniversary of NGS and the 10th anniversary of PSO2.

We delivered two major updates in NGS last year, releasing the Kvaris region in June and the Stia region in December. Moreover, we launched the PS4 version for Global in August, and even more players worldwide joined NGS as ARKS Defenders.

We held various offline events outside of the game in addition to the 10th Anniversary Project, such as ARKS EXPO 2022 at Tokyo Big Sight, NGS Kizuna Café at Tokyo Solamachi, and an exhibition as part of AX 2022 in North America.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all of you who have supported us over the past 10 years.

This year also marks the 35th anniversary of the Phantasy Star series. We are holding Sympathy 2023 on 1/20/2023 (Fri) (PST) to celebrate the 10th anniversary of PSO2 and the 35th anniversary of the PSO series. It will be our first orchestral concert in almost two years. Most of the music from NGS will be performed for the first time. We hope that those who attend the event will be able to experience the spectacular live performance, and those who cannot make it to the venue will be able to enjoy the music of the Phantasy Star series and NGS through our global live streaming.

Going back to the NGS game, following the Stia region that you have been enjoying, the final battle awaits ARKS Defenders with Dark Falz coming back in February. We hope that you will be there to witness what ARKS will learn about the secrets of planet Halpha.

There is more to come in April and May: new classes, new stories, and the NGS 2nd anniversary event. And in June, Creative Space is scheduled to be released under the title (tentative): Ultra Evolution Update.

We received a great deal of positive feedback on the content we previously shared regarding Creative Space, which has been a great encouragement to our Live Operations and Development Team.
We are sorry to keep you waiting a little longer, however, we will take your comments into consideration and work together to develop and deliver the content in better quality.

All of our team members will make every effort to ensure that everyone continues to enjoy the game.
We hope you have a great year with PSO2 NEW GENESIS!

-PSO2 New Genesis Live Operations and Development Team

The 21st of every month is PSO2 DAY for Premium Set users! We’ll also have Limited-time Tasks that everyone can enjoy, so take this chance to make the most of NGS!

*Please also note that you will receive the gifts only once during the period.

Campaign Period
11/21/2022 (Mon) 4:00 PM (PST) - 11/23/2022 (Wed) 4:00 PM (PST)

Limited-Time Tasks (All players)
PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks*For more information, please go to the in-game main menu Tasks/Quests, select Tasks, and check the Limited Time Tasks.

FUN +100%

NGS Blocks Gift Introduction item

*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.
*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.
*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.
*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them.

ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg

In PSO2 Blocks on the 1st and 21st of every month – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the ARKS Rappy will appear!

They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!

They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS!

*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.

Precautions
Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.

For more information on current campaigns, check this page!

notes.content:

The 21st of every month is PSO2 DAY for Premium Set users! We’ll also have Limited-time Tasks that everyone can enjoy, so take this chance to make the most of NGS!

*Please also note that you will receive the gifts only once during the period.

Campaign Period
10/21/2022 (Fri) 5:00 PM (PDT) - 10/23/2022 (Sun) 5:00 AM (PDT)

Campaign Information
NGS Blocks Content	
Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)
EXP Earned +20%
Rare Drop Rate +50%*For quests with fixed rewards, only the EXP Earned +20% boost will be applied.

Limited-Time Tasks (All players)
PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks*For more information, please go to the in-game main menu Tasks/Quests, select Tasks, and check the Limited Time Tasks.

FUN +100%
EXP Earned +200%
Rare Drop Rate +200%
Gathering Fever Occurrence Rate +100%*The amount of FUN points earned by consuming items that give you FUN points are not eligible for the FUN +100% Boost effect.

Boost Event (All players)

(Units/Skill Rings)
Augmentation Success Rate +15%
(Weapons/Units)
Enhancement EXP +15% when enhancing a weapon
NGS Blocks Gift Introduction item
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/61bc7804764be21a334eae1eb17556005b11d19e.jpg

*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.
*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.
*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.
*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them.

ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg

In PSO2 Blocks on the 1st and 21st of every month – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the ARKS Rappy will appear!

They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!

They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS!

*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.

Precautions
Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.

For more information on current campaigns, check this page!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg

In PSO2 Blocks on the 1st and 21st of every month – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the ARKS Rappy will appear!

They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!

They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS!

*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.

Precautions
Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.

For more information on current campaigns, check this page!

notes.title: BRAVER CLASS: INFORMATION AND CLASS SKILLS
notes.content:
Braver is now here in PSO2 New Genesis!
Braver can use two weapon types (Bow and Katana), perfect for both close and long-ranged combat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/17c7c6347da32f43a03c102e6cdee15f1295bd7c.jpg

To get started with Braver you can do so at the Class Counter! 
Be sure to expand the class selection box under Techer so that it's viewable for selection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fcd35acc5f739dc23a8aeb802a2b5637a1cafc08.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/1ce9184bb9f0c0900e992f19837bcb525afdc998.jpg

Braver Class Skills

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8aadd9fea2629e2f057167cc3a9174e9b632cf2a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d657b84bc59164a5a88f9d9486a37657ae4a8bdf.jpg

•Brave Combat (Active Skill/For Braver Weapons Only)
Reduces PP consumption and increases attack PP recovery for a fixed time. Using the skill again while already activated will launch a powerful attack. 

•Resta Effect Amplifier
Increases HP recovery amount when you use Restasigne.

•Katana Guard Counter Advanced (Katana Only)
Adds a shockwave to the Counter when performing a Perfect Guard with Weapon Action.

•Bow Elusion Plus (Bow Only)
Using a Weapon Action while pressing the directional pad at just the right time after releasing a Photon Art will make you slide while attacking.

Braver Photon Arts

•Silverleaf Storm
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/21a4b6c9cac7fee699724aaf9aed59718086f840.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2eb2a06fa6658efcc37bbefff12df201647d9ff8.jpg

Katana Photon Art. Releases a forward slash after a swift sword draw. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

•Iris Gale
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8e004585c173a0dbf3cdd4124913dcb27b66a86d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fba8a6dd1297ec60590527f1e0e070c661fa618c.jpg

Katana Photon Art. Mows down nearby enemies after a swift sword draw. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

•Lotus Lightning
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/391ebfde3c270da6bda24ddcb2f7ad0c57f010cb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/490d976c8b1659844f76704f73e4e72b3b2832e1.jpg

Katana Photon Art. Releases manifold shockwaves in a straight line after charging your sword. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

•Flex Arrow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ce33696b282c130a73eb12c979dea4fa31c3d031.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fd7025f4a54016c09509942fb7d6eb73d024bd64.jpg

Bow Photon Art. Fires homing arrows. Can be charged up to two power levels to release different attacks.

•Frenzied Firework
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/1bfe125832209b7dd5e70475a10f2adf6346e4cd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/99bcdf6b4dd4752d7580abd9fd373ef400bb0db0.jpg

Bow Photon Art. Scatters arrows all around when you hit an enemy. Charge to launch an alternate attack.

•Dimensional Ray
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/00a1bd3c9c8c41f820c40e30dcbad604f5c9d440.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/95a376f7fa3e2d0db677e7184e6ebcfd4242b6dd.jpg

Bow Photon Attack. A bow from an alternate dimension rains arrows on enemies. Charging will cause the bow to teleport and release homing attacks when you land hits with other Photon Arts. 

Braver Instructor Deirdre!
•New Side Task! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ada2df196a35ce4f63fd8631dce9873cf92d4e1f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0f6371e14c68e578abe36b18ce7f30ff3395947e.jpg

Deirdre is the newly-assigned Braver Instructor for ARKS. She’s an 18-year old Deuman, the same age as Ran. “Braver Basic Training” is a task in which ARKS Instructor Deirdre teaches the basic fighting method for the Braver class in a practical manner. Try out this task if you want to give the Braver class a try! 

New Weapon Categories!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2eace5465a916a6082e5b0fabfb2ad538a49d58a.jpg

New Katana and Bow weapon categories have been added! The Katana has been added to the 4-star rarity Foursis weapon series, and the Bow has been added to the Vialto series! Weapons of 3-star rarity or less have also been added to other weapons series, such as Trois De and Theseus series, so be sure to get them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/92af9bdd7ada6137b075678ebae197c82a28d434.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a95a99b7b41a1d7d2012047f4b0fed61b2c21795.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6d13751bbe55d678a39915090e569b678b38b7c5.jpg

notes.title: Regarding Improvements Underway to Reduce Lag During Peak Hours
notes.content:
We have confirmed that following the PSO2 NEW GENESIS launch, the increased load on servers during peak hours has been causing some parts of the game to lag.

We have identified part of the cause of this problem, and are taking measures to improve the situation. Emergency Maintenance will be conducted as soon as the preparations are complete. 

We will update everyone again regarding the expected date and time for the Emergency Maintenance once the details have been finalized.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.



- The NGS Team

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: FRAME ARMS RELOADED
notes.content:
If you’re a fan of FRAME ARMS and FRAME ARMS GIRL, be sure to check out this newest AC Scratch Ticket collection released on December 23rd! Read on for a sneak peek!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2f646022ded20dbcf82207e83f7785209cc1b8b3.jpg

If you’ve ever wanted to dress up as your favorite FRAME ARMS or FRAME ARMS GIRL, now you can with the AC Scratch Ticket collection FRAME ARMS RELOADED, coming on December 23rd! Get fully equipped with accessories and items inspired by FRAME ARMS, such as the 120mm Low-recoil Gun or the Evolution Device: BASELARD G!

[previewyoutube=7ikvS5D7qaI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: HOLIDAY WONDERLAND
notes.content:
It’s (almost) the most wonderful time of the year, Arks, and this AC Scratch and FUN Scratch ticket collections are proof! Check out what you can get, starting on December 15th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fe0e15d03ea1ba640ed1c5bb41a0e50a987db391.jpg

You operatives have been good, really good, and so ARKS HQ is sparing the coal and spoiling you with some great fashion! The HOLIDAY WONDERLAND AC Scratch Ticket collection will have you clamoring for some hot apple cider and peanut brittle while you’re decked out in cozily warm clothing! Check out the MERRY CAROLING DRESS for female operatives or snag your own * JINGLE TREE Weapon Camo! Be sure to make your list and check it twice, because Arks deserve great fashion, naughty or nice!

[previewyoutube=XMp1M9Ig5MM;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click here for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and here for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!

Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from this collection!

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: ULTIMATE TRINITY
notes.content:
Celebrate the launch of Episode 6 with some ARKS-inspired fashion! Coming on December 8th, the new AC Collection Ultimate Trinity and Part 1 of the FUN Scratch Ticket Collection for December will be out of this world!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c2d515332df8cf7704f51464407e0956576c44b4.jpg

If you’re looking for some new battle-wear, trust the ARKS pros and go with the styles in this new AC Scratch Collection, ULTIMATE TRINITY! Your ARKS Commander always has efficiency on her mind, and her wardrobe shows it, so adopt her style for your own with the Full-dress Deputy or Full-dress Commander layering pieces! Alternatively, you can shine brightly in Esta Teresa pieces or fade into the shadows in your own set of Scharf Vinto items! In any case, be sure to check out this collection, coming on December 8th!

[previewyoutube=IZmj5ul60ns;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click here for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and here for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!


AC SCRATCH TICKET
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from this collection!

Release Date: 12/08 (end of maintenance)

Price (per ticket): 200 AC

notes.title: AN ARKS HOLIDAY EVENT!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays, Arks! Check out how Fleet Oracle will be spreading the holiday cheer by examining this article!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f22f49e0a7ffce53b938d0da2d64df035b184d75.jpg

Every day Arks have something to celebrate, whether it be the eradication of an enemy or the fulfillment of a Client Order. Ultimately these tasks are about helping – or protecting – others, and that theme is featured strongly in the holiday season as well! ARKS HQ has wrapped quite a present for you this holiday season, so read on and we’ll unwrap it together!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ceb2996c0b8c822bfcc451d77127c67271ecc15b.png
QUNA’S HOLIDAY SPIRIT
Quna is feeling merry so she’s putting on performances of Eternal Encore with a holiday twist to them! Be sure to catch this special concert in the Shopping Plaza so you can experience the wintry magic with your fellow ARKS Operatives!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/9aa7a5f47defd3bce0baed11edd8cae8d152cc72.png
HOLIDAY DÉCOR 
Begins: 12/08 (PST) (end of maintenance)
Ends: 12/31 11:59 PM (PST)

The trees have been lit, and piles of snow abound in the Shopping Plaza. You know what to do, Arks! That’s right, build a snowman! The stockings have even been hung in the Gate Area! With so much festive cheer, you’re bound to get in the holiday spirit!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c8e2b0067e473e410a30c73ab26449f1730eded3.png
CHRISTMAS ON ICE
Begins: 12/08 (PST) (end of maintenance)
Ends: 12/31 11:59 PM (PST)

In the snowy and normally silent Tundra area of Naverius, things are beginning to stir. Decorations have been placed, lights have been lit, and all await the pending festivities with glee. However, there are others that have also been attracted by the hubbub, and they are not on the guest list. Falspawn and other enemies are circling, attracted by the lights and music, and sadly they are not your average opponents. Resonant and other enhanced enemies have been spotted, and it’s up to you, ARKS Operatives, to ensure that our Holiday Venue remains safe for guests. 

In groups of 12, you’ll have just 10 minutes to clear the rabble from the Venue, and Quest Points will be allotted to those who make the largest dent in the number of invaders. Naturally, as more enemies are defeated, the more intelligent and ferocious enemies will assume the defenders to have flagging spirits and will make their move; so be on your guard as your time nears its end. 

Fortunately, these enemies appear to have quite the collection of rare weapons and equipment on them, so their extermination may be to your personal benefit as well.

MERRY XIA

Xia’s got a problem, or rather, problems, and she needs your help! The holiday event venue in the Naverius Tundra  is infested with Falspawn and it’s up to you to clear it! notes.title: WHAT’S NEW IN EPISODE 6
notes.content:
There’s a LOT of content coming when Episode 6 boards the Ship, operatives! Check out this article and study up so you’re prepared!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/74295eeaa1a81419ca44d6f3b034e943376e11fb.jpg

So, you left the Sacred Magical Kingdom of Epykuento in the transcendent hands of a friend, and headed back to Fleet Oracle for some much needed R&R. The only problem is that your legendary feats in vanquishing one enemy inadvertently permitted the entry of another – and she even had the gall to thank you for it. As your experience on Alternate Dimension: Omega taught you, the universe tends to favor recycling things; though chaos often interferes and these re-creations can be – flawed. Add this to the newfound knowledge that your experience on Omega may not have been historically accurate, and you have the recipe for a grim sense of foreboding. ARKS will again need your help; to make sense of the past – and preserve the future.


There will be new training regimens, and new equipment that will better enable Fleet Oracle to meet this new challenge head-on when it arrives. Apprise yourselves of the contents of this notice, operatives, and then dispose of it in a secure manner.


WHAT’S NEW

Some of the new changes and features include:


 New Story
 Player Level cap increased to 95
 New Classes – Phantom & Étoile
 New Summoner Pets – Herbie and Vulcan
 New Urgent Quests
 New Quest Type – Risk Exploration
 Arms Extension
 New Quest Difficulty – Ultra-Hard (UH)
 New ARKS Missions
 New Rising Weapons Badge
 New Enemy Type – Luminmech and Ultra Enemies
 New Seasonal Events
 New Mission Pass Season
 Exciting new Titles to earn
 Additional Recommended Quest – Level Up Quest
 New Collection Folders – Legendary 15★ Collection Folder, 14★ Eggs Collection 1
 New Bonus Quest – Special Mission: Tokyo [Rainbow]
 New Practice Quests – Étoile, Phantom, AIS Vega
 New S-Grade Augments
 New 15★ Weapons at Zig Shop
 New 13★ Units at Zig Shop
 13★ Units can be have S-class Augments - S6, S7, S8

 

A few of the new features and changes deserve to have a little bit more said about them, so let’s get started!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a24401cdca52abdfde9f658fde868505e37c48e8.png

NEW STORY

After your victorious return from the battle in Alternate Dimension: Omega, the universe seems to be righting itself, as the massive Black Hole seems to have disappeared. The only remaining oddity left to address is the sudden appearance of someone bearing a striking resemblance to a recent acquaintance – who happens to call herself Shiva, Goddess of Annihilation. Outside of the forbidding name, perhaps most alarming is the fact that Photon Arts and Techniques appear to be totally ineffective at warding her, and her companions, off. Fortunately, her initial overture towards ARKS was brief, though its purpose was to flatly declare war.

Bolstered by an armada of her own, Shiva has deployed her forces in a standard formation – directly opposing Fleet Oracle. Though the battlespace is limitless, preparation time is not, and the most massive battle in the history of ARKS is about to begin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/67964f7324b39da2b8ecd587a24a27a60b49fe53.png

SCION CLASS - PHANTOM

A Scion Class, the Phantom adeptly uses Rods, Katanas, and Assault Rifles in a manner unique to their Class. But their advantage doesn’t end there, for they can quickly modify their Rod or Katana’s standard Photon Arts on the fly with the use of a Weapon Action, thus executing a Shift Photon Art and increasing the variety of attacks they can perform. Even their Techniques, when executed with a Rod in hand, provide an additional Technique Attack.  


In the hands of a Phantom, the Phantom Assault Rifle is used to create Phantom Bits, allowing the Phantom to continue with their Attacks and Photon Arts while deployed Bits seek and detonate upon the target. Perhaps most impressive, subsequent attacks against enemies will apply a Phantom Marker, which detonates when struck with a Charged Weapon Action.

 
Finally, Phantoms can learn the skill Phantom Time, which extends the duration of their invulnerability when sidestepping and reduces their PP consumption by 20% for a short time. Using Phantom Time Finish once the duration of Phantom Time is nearly expired will unleash a massive attack upon the Phantom’s enemies. As with all Scion Classes, you will need to level two Classes to level 75 before you are able to complete Officer Kofy’s Class Permit Trial unlocking the Phantom Class. Phantoms are also unable to select a Sub-Class, however other Classes can select Phantom as their Sub-Class.

Notable Photon Arts of the Phantom include:


 Rufkonzert - Rod Photon Art for Phantoms. Unleash a string of attacks and then let loose a shockwave. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.
 Wolkenkratzer - Katana Photon Art for Phantoms. Execute a drop attack accompanied by a shock wave. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.
 Verbrechen - Assault Rifle Photon Art for Phantoms. Launch a line of attack satellites as you move. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/898352ecffddc1fcd87d187f9d97494d8425a2cd.png

SCION CLASS - ÉTOILE

Notable in the fields of Defense and Support skills, Étoiles shine quite brightly when in the thick of battle. Capable of wielding the Double Saber, which allows for increased aerial mobility; Soaring Blades, which grant them the ability to defend while still attacking; and Wands, which provide free movement while allowing the Étoile to continue with their attacks.
 

In the hands of an Étoile, the Double Saber grants the operative high mobility, special aerial abilities, and the ability to accumulate Focus through the Focus Gauge – which is spent automatically to help mitigate incoming damage. Naturally, this Focus can also be spent on an Enhanced Attack, so it’s up to the Étoile to determine the best use of their Focus at a given time. The Weapon Action of the Étoile Double Saber is called Deflect and using it will activate a Perfect Guard. Deflect can also be used to unleash a powerful counterattack. Perhaps most notable is the Étoile’s ability to use Double Saber Skip Arts, allowing them to tailor their attacks to specific parts of their Photon Arts.


Soaring Blades allow an Étoile to Parry by using their Weapon Action. This allows them to block attacks from every direction, even when the Étoile is in the middle of a Photon Art. Étoile Soaring Blades also allow the use of the Focus Gauge, which can be spent on a powerful Connect Attack upon reaching a certain level. Building the Focus Gauge even more will unleash a Full Connect Attack.


Perhaps the most favored weapon, the Étoile Wand provides the operative with high mobility and attacks that chain together naturally. Using the Weapon Action at the right time during the use of a Photon Art will release a Focused Photon Art, which may be smaller in scope, but far more powerful. Used on its own, the Weapon Action will activate Charge Protect, providing the Étoile with defense while moving. By expending the Étoile Focus Gauge, this defensive stance can be maintained longer. Once the Focus Gauge has been depleted to a certain level, a powerful attack known as a Protect Release will occur and devastate the area surrounding the Étoile.
 

Naturally, as with the other Scion Classes, this Class is restricted to senior operatives who have reached Level 75 with two different Classes. Also, like the Phantom, Étoile can be chosen as a Sub-class.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/898352ecffddc1fcd87d187f9d97494d8425a2cd.png

Notable Photon Arts of the Scion include:


 Light Wave – Soaring Blades Photon Art. Unleashes a barrage of blows that emit shockwaves and launches a Photon Blade that pierces the enemy.
 Black Hole Rapture – Wand Étoile Photon Art. Sucks up targets into an explosion. Attack changes depending on Weapon Actions.
 Celestial Collide – Double Saber Photon Art. Release a giant Photon Blade into the enemy with a heel drop.


NEW SUMMONER PETS – HERBIE AND VULCAN

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/7bb38bc5d64558f209c977287e50e6359055a34c.png

Herbie – An evolved form of Redran (though of the same Rarity), Herbie has increased DEX (+93 at Level 130). Herbie has a new personality type, that of GENIUS. When facing a Boss-type enemy, this personality will provide increased PP recovery, faster performance of Photon Arts, and increased Normal Attack damage. Though evolved from Redran, Herbie’s Photon Arts are slightly different in that Laser affects fewer targets, the potency and range of Mine are increased in exchange for a higher PP Cost, Slash yields higher damage at the cost of more PP, Gravity requires less PP, and Burst charges faster and requires less PP but also deals less damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b72473de6f6e54b24eb6ea406c6a47bdcab238fe.png

Vulcan – The evolved form of Synchro, its nature allows for higher damage with chained Photon Arts. It has an altered personality, however, and is considered Aggressive. This personality reduces its Critical Hit Rate in exchange for greatly increased damage. It also has slightly higher Dexterity, Defense, and HP than its lesser form. Kick’s damage is greatly increased at the cost of more PP, Fist deals increased damage, and Bomb and Strike do more damage compared to their Synchro counterparts.

NEW RECOMMENDED QUESTS – LEVEL UP QUESTS

There’s a new entry in the Recommended Quests at the Quest Counter – Level Up Quests! These will also reward a Special Present at the end of the Quest, in addition to providing an additional 200% EXP!

 
NEW COLLECTION FOLDERS

Earn your way towards your next upgrade!


Legendary 15★ Collection Folder

That’s right Arks! Check out these 15★, +30 Enhancement Level Weapons!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fb0f644ddb0b2e3ff2543ff205c00f7948041b18.png


14★ Eggs Collection 1

Summoners, we heard you! Don’t miss this opportunity to earn a 14★ Pet Egg of your choosing!

FEATURED PET EGGS

 Wanda Egg | 14★
 Trim S Egg | 14★
 Sally Egg | 14★
 Marron S Egg | 14★
 Melon Egg | 14★
 Viola S Egg | 14★
 Rappy Egg | 14★
 Synchro S Egg | 14★
 Jinga Egg | 14★
 Aero S Egg | 14★
 Popple Egg | 14★
 Redran S Egg | 14★
 Herbie Egg | 14★
 Vulcan Egg | 14★


NEW ENEMY TYPES – LUMINMECH AND ULTRA HARD

Naturally, Shiva has some new baddies for operatives to play with. See below for the latest information ARKS HQ has received on them!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/52e68aaa72c5e2bcd777a250816f20e4bdab5734.png

Luminmech

Luminmech are enemies created and dispatched by Shiva, Goddess of Annhilation. Luminmech have high attack power, use heavy armor, and have unique skills that make them a very dangerous foe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0ae3514d732c2a0bfba4a361c3c71a301ffc48ea.png

Ultra Enemies

Ultra Enemies are Native inhabitants and Falspawn of each planet that have undergone an additional, corruption-induced transformation. These enemies will be encountered in Ultra Hard Difficulty Quests.

After dispatching some Ultra Enemies, operatives have reported that each has dropped a special 15★ weapon, similar to those dropped in Risk Exploration quests.

NEW QUEST TYPE – RISK EXPLORATION

Expeditions may have become less challenging as you’ve become more powerful, but that doesn’t mean there aren’t enemies out there that will truly test your mettle! Risk Explorations are the next frontier that ARKS HQ would like you to explore, but be forewarned, because these quests are only available for those who aren’t afraid to take on Ultra Hard Quests!

It takes some time (3 days) for ARKS HQ to plan out which set of areas should be explored, and when, so these will not all be simultaneously be available, as normal Expedition Quests are. You can also expect to be more challenged by the random occurrence of Emergency Trials as well, as they’ll have more difficult goals under different conditions than those that have occurred elsewhere.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/784e3bdea513e04314315104980e3caf4fde2c02.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c026e1417559ca38f7a75bdfdb3e2fdbfe411108.png
