WEAPON EXTENSION AND 13★ WEAPON CREATION

That weapon seemed perfect when you first got it, but now compared to some of the new items you’re picking up lately, it’s not so hot. The good news is that WEAPON EXTENSION Is now available in your Personal Quarters via the Crafting Terminal! Extending your (up to 12★) weapon can overwrite the standard stats with those of a selected recipe – once you’ve raised the weapon’s Extension Level enough – with the maximum level being 12. The Enhancement Level, Augments, and Weapon Potentials will not be affected.


To Extend your weapon, you’ll need some materials, most of which can be attained by Dismantling 7★ or higher equipment at the Crafting Terminal. As you Extend more items, you’ll attain Crafting Achievements, which will unlock additional, more powerful Recipes.


If you’re looking for an entirely new upgrade and the Rare Drop Rate has not favored you, you can now craft 13★ weapons at the Crafting Terminal! These weapons can then be Extended up to Extension Level 8!

RISING WEAPONS BADGE 5

The next Rising Weapons Badge, and the wares that can be purchased with them, are here! Perhaps most notably, you can now purchase Sweets for your Pets and S-Grade Augments!

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: CORRUPTED HEROES
notes.content:
It’s a harsh galaxy out there operative, and you should be prepared. Embrace the theme of survival and check out the AC Scratch Ticket collection Corrupted Heroes, coming November 24th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d7fc3d4c3072099082418c5a45a6dca26694a622.jpg

With the content of Episode 6 coming up, it’s a good idea for operatives to be prepared for diverse environments. That’s why the gear in this next AC Scratch Collection, CORRUPTED HEROES includes masks that’ll have you breathing safely no matter what vapors assault your senses. The style of the pieces is also geared towards survival, featuring tough edges and hard-wearing materials. So if you’re looking for some new pieces for Episode 6, be sure to check out this collection when it becomes available on November 24th!

[previewyoutube=eUvqkfneCyQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Operatives are multi-talented, with some of them creating some amazing designs. Check them out in this AC Scratch Ticket, Designer Dreams II!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/86c4bc188f76358669ef50a43eab4d7a29818034.jpg

ARKS Operatives aren’t always on a mission, in fact, they have quite a bit of free time to themselves. Some of them choose to spend it in a creative way, perhaps dreaming up whimsical clothing and accessories to delight their fellow operatives with. ARKS HQ is happy to announce that some more of those designs caught our attention, and we’d like to share them with you in the newest AC Scratch Ticket collection, DESIGNER DREAMS II. These pieces have various themes to them, but all can be described as “whimsical,” so they’re sure to delight. See them for yourself when they become available from your nearest Scratch Ticket Terminal on November 10th!

notes.title: THANKSGIVING IN PSO2!
notes.content:
It’s Turkey-time! Prepare yourselves (and your stomachs) for the Thanksgiving Event, coming November 11th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/85293638ba73925d92d3715799a7394c363e7734.jpg

Happy Thanksgiving, Arks! It is time to show our gratitude for those who fight to protect others, and naturally that includes operatives. The Ship has been decorated, special treats will be offered, and new holiday-themed items are available! Without further ado, let’s get into the content of the THANKSGIVING EVENT, starting November 11th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a5795f29497925a95619c8960145d724041098db.png
A CORNUCOPIA OF DECORATIONS!
If you’re hungry for Thanksgiving décor, then you’re sure to be stuffed after visiting the Shopping Plaza of your Ship. ARKS HQ has really flown the coop with the Thanksgiving theme, and Rappy takes center stage (though in this case he’d probably prefer not to.) Oh, and the Medical Bay would like to remind operatives to not eat any of the display items, regardless of how good they look. 

Begins: 11/11 (PST) (end of maintenance)
Ends: 12/08 (PST) (beginning of maintenance)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0998a792251a6f5af79ae50b28930c2f00f4ac9c.png
A FESTIVE (AND WELL-TIMED) GATHERING OF WINGED ONES 
A situation has arisen where winged creatures and Falspawn are gathering en masse on the Floating Continent of Amduskia. Little do they know, this is not the best time to be encouraging an ARKS hunt, as Xia has quite a few mouths to feed for her upcoming feast. It may be a good idea to stop by and visit her in the Shopping Plaza before heading to the Gateway ship to take on this quest. Operatives are to head to the Floating Continent and determine the reason this flock is gathering. You’ll have 30 minutes to complete your investigation, and each enemy defeated will reward you not only with combat experience, but with points, with 1126 Quest Points being required for quest completion. 

Due to the somewhat uneven terrain, ARKS HQ has deployed a few Catapults and Dash Panels that we had left over from the Summer training event. When at a Dash Panel, pressing “E” will temporarily enable high-speed movement to cross terrain. Touching another Dash Panel will extend the effect. You can jump or kick while under the effects of the Dash Panel, and the kick can be powered up 3 times by chaining the use of Dash Panels. Catapults will send you soaring in the direction indicated. Be sure to explore every inch, as some Catapults may take you to otherwise unreachable areas! So get out there and pluck some feathers so you can get your * TURKEY LEG weapon camo, which works for all weapons!

In the process of completing campaigns or gathering materials, don’t forget to take a look at your ARKS MISSIONS List every now and then, but especially for this event. ARKS HQ has added a few extra objectives for operatives to complete, and the rewards range from some Roasted Turkey to Thanksgiving Badge 2020, which can be used to purchase items from Xia’s special shop. If you need a refresher on ARKS Missions, check out this article.


ADDITIONAL CONTENT COMING NOVEMBER 11TH!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a13ccf0e928710014c2910dd0af21308488e5369.png
SURVEYING A PARALLEL WORLD
Perhaps the most extreme Ultimate Quest that any operative can undertake, SURVEY: REMNANTS OF A PARALLEL WORLD is not for the faint of heart. Only senior-ranking Arks (those above level 80 on both Main and Sub – Class) should attempt this mission, as it is to be done solo. That’s right, on your own, as the area is too unstable to allow for greater numbers of operatives. Your supplies will be limited such that Scape Dolls or Half Scape Dolls won’t save you. When the 15 minute time limit is up, or should an operative become incapacitated, participants will be extracted and the quest will be considered a failure. You’ll have 10 attempts at this quest each day, with the counter resetting at 5:00 AM (PST). A successful quest still consumes one attempt. Remaining, unused attempts do not transfer over to the next day.

Your mission briefing is fairly simple. Leadership has received signals coming from this specific sector of Alternate Dimension: Omega, and their magnitude indicate that the entity responsible is equal to the strength of the Profound Darkness. Initial probes have shown that the area is layered, with a stronger enemy present on each successive level. You will not be able to traverse the levels freely though, as defeating the prime enemy on a level will result in an ARKS extraction for a medical evaluation, mandated by HQ.


Powerful Augments
The energy of the sector seems to have influenced the items available to those who explore it, and some cursory explorations have yielded the following.

PHANTASY STAR UNIVERSE(S)
Ethan and Karen have taken their interplanetary patrolling to another world, and that’s not just a saying – they really did – since they wound up on Fleet Oracle. They’re going to need some assistance in finding a way back to their world, and so far they have no idea where to start looking. As they’re unfamiliar with the hazards of the ARKS sphere of influence, they’re going to need an escort, and you’re just the operative to do it! Not only will you have the pleasure of their company (permanently, as you can receive their Partner Cards), but you may also wind up with some weapon camos too! Check out what you’ll receive by completing their Client Orders!

★15 STAR WEAPON EXCHANGE
That’s right, they’re here – well, at Zig’s Shop actually. ARKS HQ is proud to announce the availability of 3 types of ★15 weapons; the OPHISTIA SERIES, the TRAILBLAZER XION SERIES, and the ATLAS EX SERIES. In order to acquire one of these weapons, you have a short list of materials to procure, though some of the items may require an upgrade of their own. After all, in order to get something, you have to give something, and in this case it’s a template from which Zig can work. Each series requires the submission of one (or more) ★14 weapons from specific weapon series that are enhanced to +35 Enhancement Level. These Enhancement Levels were not achieved in vain, however, as the resulting ★15 weapon will retain them. For more information on the specifics of ★15 weapon exchange at the Zig Shop, check out this article.

We hope you’re as excited as we are to share the Thanksgiving spirt! So pass the Volcanic Caves Pumpkin pie and dig in!

 

- The PSO2 Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/969499db30aff298b7795669807493f553b0b2d6.jpg

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: WEYLAND WARRIORS
notes.content:
You’ve proved you’re no pansy, but your wardrobe could probably use some more durable layering pieces. Fortunately, the new AC Scratch Weyland Warriors will be invading Scratch Ticket Terminals near you on October 28th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/08fe12f92443746965f6eb4f8c22cf164af7c69b.jpg

With a motto like “Death to the weak, life to the strong,” it’s necessary that the clothing used by the people of Weyland bear up under hard use. That’s why ARKS HQ thought it would be a great idea to introduce it to ARKS Operatives, in the next AC Scratch collection WEYLAND WARRIORS! The country that likes to fight, just for the sake of fighting, has produced some durable leather layering pieces that’ll have you covered in inclement weather as well as protect you from abrasions received on the field of battle. Once you’re ready to get cleaned up, check out the more detailed pieces with feathers and embroidery – which are sure to make you stand out from the crowd. So if you like what you see, grab a spot at a Scratch Ticket Terminal near you on October 28th! 

[previewyoutube=DIc3i_gBch0;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click here for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and here for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!


AC SCRATCH TICKET
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from this collection!

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: DARK ABYSS
notes.content:
Need a costume for a Spook-tacular party? Check out the AC Scratch collection Dark Abyss, available on October 14th! Sneak-peak available here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/535dd0e964e598efbc94cab2f12c85d63c51a23d.jpg

Who’s ready for the spookiest AC Collection to debut in 2020? ARKS HQ is happy to announce that the AC Scratch Ticket collection, DARK ABYSS, will be available beginning October 14th! We know you’ll love these Halloween-themed designs styled for some of your favorite PSO2 characters. Alongside this AC Scratch Ticket collection comes Part 2 of the FUN Scratch lineup for October! So make sure to Moon some Incapacitated Operatives (the PSO2 version, of course) and spend your FUN Points on tickets to get the items below!

[previewyoutube=NJv6AhDFsU8;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click here for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and here for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!

AC SCRATCH TICKET
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from the Dark Abyss collection!

Release Date: 10/14 12:00 AM (PDT)
Ends: 11/10 10:00 PM (PST)
Price (per ticket): 200 AC

notes.title: HALLOWEEN IN PSO2!
notes.content:
“Boo!” to you, from PSO2! We didn’t want Arks going Personal Quarters door to Personal Quarters door and possibly disturbing tired operatives, so we figured we’d throw our own Halloween Event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/7861e62b5ca2e74a9be79e96b761cb085c9ab779.jpg

Welcome to a Phantasy Star Halloween, Arks! After visiting Earth during previous quests, ARKS has decided to celebrate a beloved holiday of the inhabitants of Earth, which led to the HALLOWEEN EVENT! There’ll be candy-themed weapons and other fun things to find and explore. The new Urgent Quest TRICK OR TREAT!, the introduction of the Expedition BEWITCHED WOODS, costumed Rappys and Emperappys, decked-out Xia, and more, await operatives of Fleet Oracle! Check out the individual sections below to learn more about each facet of the Halloween Event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/89ca85539ce02632dcaee49aa32c17e1c8355394.png

DÉCOR THEME: SPOOK-TOBER!
Your ship’s Gateway Area has been decked out in Halloween-themed decorations, so that operatives are kept in the Halloween-spirit while dancing, showing off costumes, and of course, accepting Quests from the Quest Counter. For those who spend more time in the Shopping Plaza, pumpkins and autumnal-themed items have been put on display. Please refrain from carving any pumpkins, however. 

Begins: 10/13  (PDT) (end of maintenance)
Ends: 11/10 (PDT) (beginning of maintenance) 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0423ecb907e7a5be4af6eb6f28fc5ea09d7478f5.png

PARTY CRASHERS
In the limited-time Urgent Quest, TRICK OR TREAT, you’ll need to help clear out an area on Lillipa that was to be a party venue for Arks. However, rampaging Falspawn and Automata apparently decided to crash the party, and ARKS HQ needs 8 operatives to take on the role of bouncer (role, not class) to eject the unwelcome guests.  The festival was going to include the use of Turrets and Energy Tanks (don’t ask how) so the presence of these should be helpful in clearing out the interlopers. Those of you who come wearing something special will be eligible for a PSE OUTFIT BONUS EFFECT! This boost will net operatives increased EXP gain as well as an increased rare item drop rate for the duration of their current instance of Trick or Treat! So before heading to the Quest Counter, check to see if you have any of the items in this article!

Featured Rewards

FRANCA’S AFTER DARK
If you’re looking for a great spot to host your own Costume Party, then Franca’s has got you covered. Watch fireworks flit across the City skyline while sipping drinks from a nearby bar and reclining in alcoves alongside the infinity-edge pool. We’re certain at least a few Arks will prefer this over the Lobby as the new gathering place! Just don’t be spooked if a few friendly ghosts prefer it too!

Begins: 10/13 (PDT) (end of maintenance)
Ends: 12/08 (PDT) (beginning of maintenance)

BEWARE THE LANTERN RAPPY (AND EMPERAPPY)!

GHOSTLY BINGO!
Who doesn’t love Bingo when there are prizes up for grabs?! Probably not Arks, which is good, because they’ll be able to access the HALLOWEEN 2020 BINGO card in the Halloween Event. As you take on quests, you’ll be informed when you’ve completed a task and the Bingo square number will be briefly displayed at the bottom of your screen. Your ARKS Bingo Card can be accessed through the main menu, then selecting “Current Events” and “ARKS Bingo Card.” To view what tasks you have yet to complete, click on the name of the ARKS Bingo Card–in this case “Halloween 2020 Bingo”–and select “View Details.” The tab that displays by default is named “View Bingo Card,” and this is where you can view remaining squares to be completed. The other Tab is named “Bingo Completion Reward” and this is where you view what rewards you have yet to receive. Finally, the number of times you get a “BINGO” –all squares completed in a straight line, may or may not include the “Free” space in the middle– may qualify you for one of the rewards listed below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/19e37b84de0fb7889741b1dd9a5e1653a74ae2fa.png

ADDITIONAL CONTENT COMING ON OCTOBER 14TH!
Ever fancy a walk in the woods, at night? If so, then check out the spooky new Expedition, Bewitched Woods, which fits perfectly with the Halloween theme. A massive, winding forest has appeared on Omega and it’s up to you (and up to 11 other operatives) to chart its paths and determine its hazards. Minotaurqz, Omega Salamanders, Omega Dark Falz, and others are hiding in the gnarled trees, so beware of potential ambushes. This Expedition isn’t all risk and no reward though, as the items these enemies have upon their persons are often of great value; items like the CHAOS MALOSSISTONE (used in Zig products for Supernatural weapons), for instance. ARKS HQ has mandated that in order to venture into these frightful woods, you’ll need to be at least level 55 and have cleared a particular Client Order. Check out some of the potential items that may drop while in the Bewitched Woo:ds!

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: LEGENDARY HEROES
notes.content:
Step out of legend with these heroic looks from the new AC Scratch collection, Legendary Heroes, available starting on September 30th! Check out this article for more details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/af4834fed668fd960e82ac774eac60c691a2e7b0.jpg

As ARKS Operatives are heroes to so many, inhabitants of the Fleet and Harukotan, Lillipans, and those residing in Omega, it is only fitting that they look the part. In the case of Omega, operatives seem to have stepped from the pages of legend, making them LEGENDARY HEROES, which happens to be the title of the next AC Scratch Ticket collection. This collection features regal pieces that are sure to inspire others to look upon operatives with a mixture of wonder and pride. Get your favorites from this collection between September 30th and October 27th, before the book is closed!

[previewyoutube=GpGDhvO85v0;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside this AC Scratch Ticket collection comes Part 3 of the FUN Scratch lineup for September! Check out the FUN pieces further below!

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click here for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and here for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!

notes.title: WHAT’S NEW IN EPISODE 5
notes.content:
If you’re ready for a phantastical adventure, then prepare yourselves operatives, because Episode 5 launches on September 30th! Read this article for details on what’s included!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8eb2ac179d8a9fbe718a11b0df059b1ec9758312.jpg

The time for EPISODE 5 is drawing nigh, and operatives should prepare for its arrival on September 30th!

Finding yourself on a fog-enshrouded, flower-dotted plain, a strong sense of displacement and confusion fills you. You had been mid-battle with the Profound Darkness, yet again, in an attempt to sever its corruptive hold on Persona. Suddenly, you feel the vibration of riders approaching, and spot a girl astride a scaled mount, fleeing other riders atop similar beasts. A confrontation seems imminent, and you briefly have time to reflect on what this new mystery will bring in the way of adventure.

Episode 5 brings quite a bit of new content and features, and though you have but a few moments before the party is upon you, you muse over the changes that are to take place on September 30th.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f23dab5ba018e8110aed5428ec9a9a4a4d4b7e4e.png
WHAT’S NEW
Some of the new changes and features include: 


Player Level cap increased to 90
New ARKS Missions
New Seasonal Events
New Alliance Quarters
Exciting new Titles to earn
New Collection Folder
New quest types
New areas to explore
New S-Grade Augments
Ability to transfer S-Grade Augments
Ability to add a L-Ring Skill to ★12 Units


A few of the new features and changes deserve to have a little bit more said about them, so let’s get started!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/296328d1f8bb0bc480a0b68d018bd081e78612f1.png
NEW STORY
After lending aid to those on Earth, ARKS discovers a mysteriously created portal that leads to another dimension, called “Omega.” This world seems driven purely by fantasy, a world of swords and magic instead of technology and science. The two worlds are in direct contrast with each other, and as the story progresses the player will frequently move between them while observing the strange similarities these worlds share. Simultaneously, a mysterious woman who calls herself “Alma” appears, and she seems to have information about Omega and–strangely–about ARKS.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8668823a1d203608f3be8df27b651a2d06b5f323.png
SCION CLASS - HERO
A new type of class has come to Fleet Oracle, the HERO CLASS. Heroes are trained in the use of several weapons, including: Swords, Twin Machine Guns, and Talises. But this class wouldn’t be the powerhouse it is if the Hero wielded these weapons in the style of other classes. No, their methods are unique amongst the Classes, in that Twin Machine Guns are suitable for ranged combat and can grant PP recovery mid-fight, Talises grant the Hero the ability to move to pre-determined locations at high-speed, and Swords decimate packs of enemies with a wide-range attack. Perhaps most interestingly, Heroes possess specific Photon Arts that allow them to quickly change between all three weapon types while in combat, making the Hero a self-reliant whirlwind of destruction that can adapt to changing situations on the battlefield with ease.

Notable Photon Arts of the Hero include:

Trickflash – Sword Photon Art for Heroes. Execute a high-speed thrust. Holding the button will swap to your Talis and unleash a follow-up strike.
Jet Wheel - Talis Photon Art for Heroes. Deploys a shuriken which spins about, slicing up targets. The shuriken remains active even if you swap to another Hero weapon.
Starfire Squall – Twin Machine Guns Photon Art for Heroes. Pelt enemies with a one-handed barrage of fire. Performing this Photon Art after dodging an attack will increase its damage.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f8fb2afdf97f26e0309ffde31cd6407d066f1ffa.png
DARK BLAST
By harnessing the power that you’ve accumulated from Dark Falz, you are able to perform an ability called DARK BLAST. During Dark Blast, your HP and other basic traits are greatly enhanced, and different, more powerful attacks become available to you. Dark Blast is only useable once per quest, and the ability to use it depends on the status of a gauge that fills as you fight enemies. Once in Dark Blast Form, you’re able to use any special Dark Blast skills you may have acquired after spending accumulated Special EXP, which is built up by defeating enemies in a quest and gained upon quest completion.

DARK BLAST ABILITIES

Dark Barrier – raises a large Photon wall in front of you, which draws enemy attacks.
Ultimate Impact – Only useable once per transformation, this skill allows you to channel Photon energy into your arms and release it in a focused blast of destruction. Has a large area of effect and deals extreme damage.
HP Up – Boosts your Max HP.


ADDITIONAL DARK BLAST SKILLS

Extend Normal Attack Combo ½ - add extra stages to your Normal Attacks, such as a fourth attack.
Bloody Heal – Recovers HP for you and allies around you.
Physical Dash – Dash at high Speed for a limited time.


SPECIAL DARK BLAST PHOTON ARTS

Punishment Knuckle - Unleash a devastating punch after charging. Charging results in greatly enhanced attack power. So powerful that Demon Bulwarks in Buster Quests take only one punch to destroy.



A WORLD DIVIDED - OMEGA
The world of Omega is divided amongst 4 nations.

CUENTO, a land of nature and magic; but also a land embroiled in civil war between those on the side of righteousness in the Revolutionary Army, and those who back a Pretender to the throne who seeks personal gain through any means necessary. This includes the consumption of Ephemera to fuel an unquenchable thirst for power, and obstinately ignoring the maddening effect Ephemera has on the user. Absolute power corrupts absolutely, after all.

WEYLAND is a land of parched plains and billowing dust. The wind, as it whittles the landscape, also whittles the people who reside there, molding them into volatile, combative, hardened warriors who are also experiencing civil unrest. Having attained his position through combat with all who would oppose them, their Emperor is not content to rule in peace, but would rather continue to challenge any he deems as worthy adversaries. Some would say this continual thirst for needless bloodshed borders on madness.

EPYK, a land of extremes in both its geology and people. The terrain vacillates between lush oases and barren dunes, while the people (and their Queen) are mercurial in temperament and passionate by nature. The Queen of Epyk craves excitement in her sand-filled days and may look to current events to get it. 

YS ARTIA is a forest-dotted woodland, with green rolling hills and ocean breezes that invite visitors and residents alike to savor peace and tranquility; making it a popular destination for those wishing to relax. Their newly ascended Symbol wishes the same, but the demands of governing weigh heavy on his young shoulders and he has become resigned to his administrative future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c2fa3e6370bbe1090bf210c0aa3696cc1bd2fde3.png
NEW ENEMIES – SUPERNATURALS
SUPERNATURALS are a new foe for ARKS Operatives and are created by way of sorcerous summoning–catalyzed by Ephemera. Our research thus far shows that in general, the group does not seem to have any kind of shared weakness, and instead seem to have weaknesses dependent on their individual characteristics. Operatives have encountered the Omega Wolf, Foi Sorcerers, and Resta Golems so far.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/5e1c3cbc3860a956b104c59c8055843697f76ce2.png
NEW QUEST TYPE – BUSTER QUEST
Perhaps the most formidable of Supernaturals, the Castrum Demonica is a fortification capable of summoning an endless wave of creatures and Demonic Arms such as Conjured Artillery, Ephemera Cores, and Demon Artillery. Though the Castrum Demonica are greatly feared, it has been shown that Guardians are able to control a siege weapon called a BUSTER TOWER. This will potentially change the fate of Omega, as those who seek to do good by restoring the land to a peace known before the appearance of Ephemera can now take a stand against those who seek domination.
 
Features of Buster Quests:

On a team of 8 operatives, you will alternate between the Defense Phase and the Buster Phase.
Defense Phases require defending your siege bases, known as Buster Towers, from enemies.
Buster Phases entail attacking the front line and protecting BUSTER PILES–weaponry needed to assault the walls of the Castrum Demonica.
Mana collected from the field is used for a variety of large-scale ARKS weaponry and support abilities.
As your number of cleared Buster Quests grows, your GRADE increases. A higher Grade means better rewards.
In general, you will be matched with operatives who have a similar grade.


Featured Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/59d0b6aa271864dadaf80e20088e9576209ff69a.png
Demonia Saber | ★14 Sword

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/db3bc9822ca01158262b89d62bc9aa536769f5ff.png
Ivlida Hander | ★13 Sword

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/1647de8f352316ce7aca72d8973b745f047c5ded.png
Cleasis Dinares | ★13 Twin Machine Guns

and Cleasis Boosters!


BUSTER MEDAL EXCHANGE SHOP
BUSTER MEDALS can be collected in Buster Quests as well, and these can be used as currency at the BUSTER MEDAL EXCHANGE SHOP.

The below weapons show different upgrade stages of the ★13 Sword, Ivlida Hander, which can be obtained via Buster Quests. With the collection and submission of 60 CLEASIS BOOSTERS (also obtained from Buster Quests) alongside an Ivlida Hander to Zig in the Shopping Plaza, the Cleasis Hander shown below will be obtained. Similarly, after 60 SCHVELLE BOOSTERS have been collected and handed in (by giving Zig 10 Cleasis Boosters for 1 Schvelle Booster) alongside a Cleasis Hander, the Schvelle Hander shown below will be obtained.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a624ef91b556c0f405d52b3b8a3c7fcab277738f.png
Cleasis Hander| ★13 Sword

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ac85870ce39e790a92c1a9c30e77cc9505142fa5.png
Schvelle Hander | ★13 Sword

There are many different types of Ivlida Weapons that can be upgraded in this way, so get your favorite and start collecting Cleasis Boosters!


RISING WEAPONS BADGE 4
The next Rising Weapons Badge, and the wares that can be purchased with them, are here!

Featured Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0d9969fe099ea83080c8e1a0438e9a67289af5d0.png
Jutus Crys | Wired Lance, ★13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/cba48cc4cf2cf6e822f0e4668ce19aaee4e56087.png
Jutus Legant | Knuckles, ★13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/33e8c940162d9ccfd2bd9f06d28b666a866c49cc.png
Jutus Harmony | Harmonizer, ★13

We hope you’ve enjoyed this glimpse of the content in Episode 5, and hope you’ll join us September 30th when the real fun begins! See you in a Buster Quest, Arks!

Click here to go back to the Road to Episode 5 event page! 


- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: STAR KEEPER
notes.content:
Prepare yourselves for another AC Scratch, operatives! Star Keeper arrives on August 26th and these looks pair nicely with the newly released Episode 4 content! See this article for more details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/3df1a27252d049596c182e1a82dbb4440b0f3b0f.jpg

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: EARTH DEFENDERS
notes.content:
Ready for a new you? Then prepare for the latest AC Scratch ticket collection, Earth Defenders, arriving August 19th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/34fc78ccf6a6f6fc26c31c0f4aa96d102122595e.jpg

With the arrival of Episode 4, we’ve all gotten a good look at some of the trends the new ARKS crew-members prefer, and many of you have asked when you’d be able to get your hands on some similar threads. Well, ARKS HQ has heard you, and would like to announce the release of the latest AC Scratch Ticket collection, EARTH DEFENDERS, on August 19th!

[previewyoutube=XGuxPt2DCeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click here for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets! By purchasing AC Scratch Tickets you have a chance to obtain special items, including Outfits, Accessories, and Enhancement Items!

AC SCRATCH TICKET
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from the Earth Defenders Collection!

Release Date: 08/19, 12:00 AM (PDT)
Ends: 09/15, 11:00 PM (PDT)
Price (per ticket): 200 AC
*Release date and time are subject to change due to server maintenance.

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: PERSONA PARADOX
notes.content:
The newest AC Scratch Ticket collaboration is here, bringing items from multiple titles of the legendary Persona series! Read this article for more details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a933ab6494bbbb09acc92f59994a4bce2b163fe9.jpg

Prepare to face your true self, Arks! We are proud to announce our newest AC Scratch Ticket collaboration, featuring items from the acclaimed Atlus’ JRPG series, Persona! The PERSONA PARADOX has come to Phantasy Star Online 2 as of August 12th!

Join S.E.E.S, the Investigation Team, and the Phantom Thieves with iconic outfits, music tracks, and more from Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 3, Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4, Persona 5, Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight, and Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight packed into a single release!

[previewyoutube=S80zcZyoq4s;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click here for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets! By purchasing AC Scratch Tickets you have a chance to obtain special items, including Outfits, Accessories, and Enhancement Items!

AC SCRATCH TICKET
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from Persona Paradox!

notes.title: SUMMER IN PSO2!
notes.content:
If you’re looking for fun in the sun, look no further than the Summer Event in PSO2! Check out this article for more details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c8857d622edbcd70f4cb707d9c6e6091b0af8a44.jpg

Arks around the globe have come to PSO2, along with Summer! It’s a fabulous time to celebrate the beachy weather and new recruits, and so ARKS HQ has decided to hold a Summer Event from August 5th to September 2nd! Items of interest during this time include new Urgent Quests, Summer-related Client Orders from Xia, a décor overhaul in various areas, Summer BINGO, and more! Features in the event may reward powerful new weapons and some unique cosmetic items! Without further ado, let’s dive into some of the features coming in PSO2’s Summer Event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/3a696b1910e9bdc9f765d8436b23a65e16e0a052.png


SUMMER-TIME BOOST

The heat may discourage some from wanting to train, so ARKS HQ has decided to implement some Ship-Wide and Extreme Quest Boosts to encourage Arks to get out and enjoy the summer. If you’re looking for an item upgrade or some experience gain, then now is the time to pack your calendar with missions and quests!


SHIP-WIDE BOOSTS!
Begins: 8/5 (end of maintenance)
Ends: 8/12, 12:59 AM (PDT)


EXP Earned +50%
Rare Item Drop Rate +50%


EXTREME QUEST BOOSTS!
Begins: 8/5 (end of maintenance)
Ends: 8/12, 12:59 AM (PDT)


Meseta Earned +50%


*Rates of Boost Effects may change per orders from ARKS HQ.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/09c388fb2838ea0d77d1c7787497996955f328f9.png

DÉCOR THEME:  FUN IN THE SUN

notes.title: CHALLENGE OTHERS IN THE BATTLE ARENA!
notes.content:
Spending your free time in the training ring may not seem like as much fun as the Casino, but with the Battle Arena it will be! See this article for more details about this exciting feature coming to PSO2 NA on August 5th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b38f30f1050029b4ed7ed0b2d2ad2a62ea629a3e.jpg

That’s right Arks. Want to test your mettle against your fellow operatives, or sharpen your “adapt-and-conquer” skills? If so then you’re in luck, because the BATTLE ARENA has arrived with Episode 4!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d24ca9233a69037ad4d98d64b222a469ea0930a9.png

NEW ARKS ON THE BLOCK
Your PvP experience will begin by using the Block Transporter to take you to the BATTLE LOBBY on the UNIVERSAL SHIP. Yes, you heard that correctly. The Universal Ship is a Ship accessible by all Arks, regardless of their home Ship. Players from different Ships can thus play together—or against each other-- in the Battle Arena or Challenge Quests. Navigation to the Universal Ship can be accomplished via the Quest Counter or by using the Teleporter.

A NEW PVP EXPERIENCE, EVERY TIME
In addition to being matched with different people to test your skills against, each PvP experience will also see you using different Photon Arts, Techniques, and weapons that are all particular to the combat area (map) you selected. As in Challenge Quests, you do not bring Mags, Units, Weapons, Class habits, Photon Arts, or Techniques from your home Ship to the Battle Block; just the outfit or layering-wear on your back and your will to prevail.  You are dubbed a “Battle Warrior,” and the equipment given to you at the start of each match will be random. Depending on your success in the arena, you’ll earn BATTLE COIN and ARENA POINTS. Battle Coins can be traded for very rare items at the BATTLE COIN EXCHANGE SHOP, while Arena Points will determine your BATTLE RANK.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/e83bed4ad9056067b389cdae2b76388055ad9fe6.png

WHERE DO YOU RANK?
All Operatives are ranked based on their total Arena Points earned between 7:00 AM (PDT) on the 1st of each month and 7:00 AM (PDT) on the 1st of the following month. Beginning at 7:00 AM (PDT) on the 1st of the current month, operatives can receive their Ranking Rewards from the ARKS League Officer on their Ship. Ranking Rewards usually consist of STAR GEMS (SG) and can be seen below. You can also view your own Battle Ranking Information by utilizing the Main Menu, then highlighting Content Information, and then selecting Battle Arena Information. The Battle Lobby also features a Battle Monument where you can view overall Battle Ranking information. Battle Rank is determined by accrued Arena Points (ARP), and correspond to the the ranks shown below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/80132dfa931c2bd97de1e1c98da656586923f147.png

TO RANK, OR NOT TO RANK

Ranked Matches are random battles, where you’ll be randomly matched with ARKS Operatives from any block in the Battle Lobby, based on an operative’s BATTLE RANK. Battle Ranks are determined according to the total Arena Points that an operative possesses, with those who win more often in Ranked Matches being likely to be of higher Battle Rank. In these Matches, you cannot choose your opponents, but you will acquire Battle Coins, Reward Items, and your Arena Points will be affected by the outcome. The higher an operative’s Battle Rank is, the more Battle Coins they will receive when a battle ends. Also, those with higher Battle Ranks will find themselves receiving more extravagant rewards when the ranking period is done.

Password Matches allow you to enjoy private battles with friends and other operatives by making password entry required in order to join. Therefore, you can choose who you battle. However, in these Matches you will not earn Battle Coins or Arena Points.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a028d46f2ec1ea3854e9c519b46ebaecb3ee3c23.png

MULTIPLE MODES TO CONQUER
As if all this wasn’t exciting enough, ARKS HQ isn’t just going to throw you all together in one type of melee. Oh no, you’ll have the choice of battling in EMBLEM SCRAMBLE or 4 VS 4 VR ARENA, with the winner being declared after the allotted amount of time has passed.


Emblem Scramble consists of 12 operatives who selected the quest at the same time on the selected Field (Map). The operatives will be split into 2 teams. Operatives cannot select their opponents or allies. Each operative will earn EMBLEM POINTS and when the allotted time has passed, the team with the most total Emblem Points will win! Teams will each consist of 6 Arks, and weapons are randomized. When an operative is defeated, the vanquisher will steal 10% of the of vanquished player’s points.

4 VS 4 VR Arenas can only be selected when selecting Password Matches. The rules are the same as a normal Emblem Scramble, with the team who collects the most Emblem Points being declared the winner and teams consisting of four players. There are five possible weapons you can use: swords, assault rifles, rods, jet boots, and bows.


SHOW ME THE REWARDS
BATTLE COIN BARTERER RALAF, on the second level of the Shopping Plaza, has a few neat items available for the right amount of Battle Coins. Here are a few!

Battle Coin Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/bce17a72fc1667a46089bff712e4edd27c51ba88.png
Rappy Suit Mini | Outfit, Unisex, All Races

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/9ddb954505a20fb3cc9889a6a5b87f0ad9e9491f.png
* Battle Twin Daggers | Weapon Camo, Twin Daggers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/14bae9951709808135086223b2106a3cb859fa3d.png
Rappy Makeup | Makeup

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/163342f5ca2452b12c1969651fe37483d22d4bc0.png
436: Ninja


The Battle Arena is just one more feature ARKS HQ is thrilled to introduce to PSO2 NA alongside Episode 4, and we can’t wait to hear of the heroic feats that are sure to take place during these brawls! See you in the Battle Lobby, Arks!


- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: LEVEL UP FASTER WITH BONUS QUESTS!
notes.content:
Ready to power through a couple of levels? The prospect is much less daunting when you know that Bonus Quests are coming on August 5th! Read this article for more details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/dbd241d3a628f57facded04fa73a2bd94ab03522.jpg

Feel like going on a solo-adventure to a land of bountiful EXP, Meseta, and Rare Item Drops? If so, then you should be thrilled to know that BONUS QUESTS are arriving in PSO2 NA on August 5th! These quests require the consumption of specific BONUS KEYS, which are often awarded to operatives by ARKS HQ for various reasons. To learn more about Bonus Keys, read on Arks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/15d0f99d077789133f6f9843f6aea42ea40c9d02.jpg

WHERE DO THEY COME FROM

ARKS HQ rewards operatives who perform exceptionally well, so one way to have a chance at Bonus Keys is to clear Recommended Quests at A Rank or better. There’s a reason ARKS HQ wants you to do these quests, so it behooves them to reward you for it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0615d182379092f6932d2eb5071f4e9144815036.jpg

WHERE DO THEY GO
Bonus Keys are consumed upon the start of the quest. If you disconnect from the server or abandon the quest, the Key will not be returned, so make sure you’re ready.

TIMING IS EVERYTHING
The goal of Bonus Quests is to take your enemies down quickly. This will help you earn the largest amount of EXP, Meseta, and items. Give this goal, these Bonus Quests will have Time limits of usually 10 minutes (some are 4 minutes). There are no level restrictions, so you can jump into them right away. However, these must be undertaken as solo ventures, so no Alliance members or Partner characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d656b2938bb280ead0ba4558d73f778169d20b81.jpg

THE GOODS
A great variety of items can be found in these quests, besides weapons and units with a tendency to be on the rarer side. Such items can include crafting materials such as minerals and jewels from various planets. Some Arks have even reported receiving STAR GEMS and ASTRACITE after completion of these quests. Astracite, of course, can be exchanged with Astracite Exchanger Nautbraugher on the second floor of the Shopping Plaza.


 That’s it Arks! See you at the Quest Counter!


- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: PSO2 ON STEAM: HOW TO LINK YOUR ACCOUNT
notes.content:
Ready to bring your PSO2 experience to Steam? Or want the ability to play through Windows 10, Steam, or from your couch with an Xbox One? If so, then check out this must-read article to learn about linking your Steam and Xbox Live accounts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fba320a66eba799b6d918786375932123030a77e.jpg

Fleet Oracle has gained a few new bells and whistles to add to the pool of features Arks are already familiar with. Perhaps most notably, there’s a new way to drive your experience of Phantasy Star Online 2–using Steam! That’s right operatives, that “other PC platform” has arrived. Along with the release of the Steam platform of PSO2, an account-linking feature has been added that will allow accounts used on Xbox One and Windows 10 to be played on Steam, therefore preserving your past play-time.

ATTENTION: Do not start Phantasy Star Online 2 on a new platform until you fully understand this account-linking process. Creating a character/setting up a Player ID on a new platform is irreversible and you will not be able to link your account after the fact.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/55c650c98506714d3d5fdec6367d7ebf6d45b266.jpg

LINKING YOUR ACCOUNTS
There are two ways to link your Xbox Live and Steam accounts; initiating the process from the Steam platform, or from the Xbox One or Windows 10 platform. In each case, you’ll begin the process from the platform that you have been using. We’ll outline the process for both.

If you’d like to begin using the Steam platform to play PSO2 and want to link your Xbox One or Windows 10 account:


From the Support Menu within the Start Menu of the Windows 10 or Xbox One version of PSO2, select the option to issue an account-linking code. This code will expire after 15 minutes.
After launching PSO2 on the Steam platform, select your Ship and then enter the code from the previous step. Please be careful: you can only use this code when setting up your account on a new platform for the first time. Do not create a new character/set up a Player ID before linking your account.
Success! The operative can now play using the same PSO2 save data on either their Xbox Live or Steam Account ID.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/4588716b27c292a70aa113bc70fefd2d89f550d4.jpg

If you’d like to begin using the Xbox One or Windows 10 platform to play PSO2 and want to link your Steam account:


From the Support Menu within the Start Menu of the Steam platform of PSO2, select the option to issue an account-linking code. This code will expire after 15 minutes.
After launching PSO2 on Windows 10 or Xbox One, select your Ship and then enter the code from the previous step. Please be careful: you can only use this code when setting up your account on a new platform for the first time. Do not create a new character/set up a Player ID before linking your account.
Success! The operative can now play using the same PSO2 save data on either their Xbox Live or Steam account.


*Entering the account-linking code is only possible during the first-time log-in when using the new platform.
**The same account-linking code cannot be used more than twice.
***If the first account-linking code is not used, and a new one is issued, only the newest account-linking code will be active.
****If a user inputs the account-linking code incorrectly, 10 times in a row, after the 10th time the user will not be able to link accounts until 24 hours have passed. This measure is for the safety of your account.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f1149ed3d524204dc71630c9f2dfc16941ea154d.jpg

UNLINKING YOUR ACCOUNT FROM YOUR SECONDARY PLATFORM

You cannot unlink your account from the first platform that you used to play PSO2. This process is non-reversible, so make sure it’s what you really want, operative! In each case, you’ll begin the process from the secondary platform you would like to discontinue using. We’ll outline the process for both.

If you’d like to discontinue usage of the Steam platform and it is not the original platform you used to connect to PSO2:

Log-in to PSO2 from the Steam platform using the Steam account that you’d like to Unlink.
Select “Unlink Account” from the Start Menu of PSO2.
Confirm your desire to Unlink your accounts by entering the specified key in the confirmation window and selecting “Yes”.
Your PSO2 save data on your Steam account will be deleted.

If you’d like to discontinue usage of the Windows 10 or Xbox One platform and it is not the original platform your used to connect to PSO2:

Log-in to PSO2 from the Windows 10 or Xbox One platform using the Xbox Live account that you’d like to Unlink.
Select “Unlink Account” from the Start Menu of PSO2.
Confirm your desire to Unlink your accounts by entering the specified key in the confirmation window and selecting “Yes”.
Your PSO2 save data on your Xbox Live account will be deleted.



We’re thrilled to bring operatives together through these different platforms, as well as enlist the aid of Arks from an additional 33 countries! August 5th marks the beginning of not only the newest Episode in Phantasy Star Online 2, but the birth of an expanded PSO2 Community as well, and we couldn’t be more excited! See you in the Lobby, Arks!

- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: WHAT’S NEW IN EPISODE 4
notes.content:
Ready for Episode 4, but still trying to figure out what you’re most excited about? Check out this article for a review of the features and content arriving in our first episode release in the West!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/95abe5e56a20ed62c22339ccfa15708d2385e3c5.jpg

The time is finally here, Arks! The next major content update, EPISODE 4, arrives on August 5th!

Give those arms a stretch after coming out of Cryo-sleep and make sure you don’t feel any lingering effects of corruption from your encounter with the Profound Darkness in Episode 3. About 2 years has passed, and Fleet Oracle has a new commander. Some oddly-behaving Arks have recently been spotted among the Ships, and Commander Ulc needs you to investigate to ensure they are who they say they are. She’s also tasked you with finding out if there’s any relation between the odd Arks and the recently discovered planet, Earth.

Under the new command, a few things have been added, and ARKS HQ wants to make sure you’re apprised of what to expect when Episode 4 arrives. Please keep your hands and arms inside the Gateway Ship, as we start off on a brief tour of the included content!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2be5c0ddeb9e8948634a486f62d1725726d84d9c.jpg

WHAT’S NEW
Some of the new changes and features include:


Global access for an additional 33 countries
Player Level cap increased to 80
Photon Art and Technique Levels increased to 17
New Skills available from Player Level 76 to 80
Introduction of PvP in the BATTLE ARENA
New PSO2 Friend List, separate from Xbox Live Friend List
Character slot maximums have increased to 20
New ARKS Missions
Universal Ship for Battle Arena and Challenge Quests
BONUS Quests for huge amounts of EXP, Meseta, and material items!
New Seasonal Events
New Alliance Quarters, including Tokyo, Battleship, and Lunar Surface
Characters from the Anime series of Phantasy Star Online 2 will appear on the Ship, and can join your party after completing specific Client Orders!
Exciting new Titles to earn
New enemy types to challenge
New quest types
New areas to explore
Preview your purchases in the Fresh Finds Shop
Send your Material Items automatically to the Storehouse
Season 6 of the Mission Pass


A few of the new features and changes deserve to have a little bit more said about them, so let’s get started!


CRAFTING

CRAFTING has finally come to PSO2! This will allow operatives to customize armor, Techniques, and Photon Arts! Crafting can be accessed via the Personal Terminal in your Personal Quarters or from the Mini-Room. Each crafting type will have a “Crafting Level,” which can be increased by completing Crafting Achievements. Increasing your level can impart bonus effects when crafting!

To summarize the benefits:


Equipment Extension (Units) allows you to re-write the basic values of a Unit
Customize the abilities, speed, and potency of Photon Arts
Customize the potency, speed, number of hits, or range of Techniques
Add a Timed Ability to a Unit, such as one that increases a recovery or attack power effect
Dismantle unwanted items and receive the material items for crafting
Daily Crafting Orders will arrive
Receive Crafting Orders from other operatives

 
There’s a lot to learn, operative, so make sure to check it out for yourself!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/deb7b195794fb208b683f6901d1432812866ad6a.jpg
 

A NEW PLANET TO EXPLORE
With new Expeditions to explore Tokyo and Las Vegas, operatives will have plenty to do in Episode 4. New features in these areas will include the ability to move freely throughout the map, and include the use of new modes of transportation–Ridroids! Additional Ridroid Quests can also be accepted via the Quest Counter, if you find yourself becoming fond of them. Of course, these new areas mean there are new items to find in them, and a few of them include:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2a2939d555ed9294e5e83f1f424cff1e1b1eb130.png
S. CN Mantis | Soaring Blades, ★13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b346f5426f92c0a0c040c68ccee5893d50565807.png
Quotz Vidiya | Knuckles, ★13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/19188ac15209fc5a4b8311a5f98ba780c62fbe6a.png
Sieger Archer | Bow, ★13


PIT YOURSELF AGAINST FELLOW ARKS
PvP has made its way to the Ships! Well, the UNIVERSAL SHIP, that is. This Ship will host operatives from the whole fleet who are desirous of testing their might against their fellow Arks in the BATTLE ARENA, as well as those looking for allies to undertake CHALLENGE QUESTS. In the Battle Arena, defeating opponents and claiming victory in your matches will earn you Battle Coin, which can be redeemed at the Battle Coin Exchange Shop. There is also a LIMITED EXCHANGE menu where SG can be purchased with Battle Coins every week! You can purchase 10SG up to 5 times and 5SG up to 10 times for a total of 100SG! For a sneak peak at what else you can earn, see below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/20e73243aa92b16c2135b0aaaa824afd5a8956a9.png
* Jilad Zahal | Weapon Camo, Knuckles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/17286924992515886440a4ce0d8c14f096a74f25.png
* Jilad Assan | Weapon Camo, Gunblade

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/bce17a72fc1667a46089bff712e4edd27c51ba88.png
Rappy Suit Mini | Outfit, Unisex, All Races


RISING WEAPONS BADGE 3
If you’ve outgrown your previous Rising Weapons Badge gear, or want to be on solid footing as a rookie, start earning these new badges and exchange them in the Shopping Plaza for powerful rewards! A few notable weapons include:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/9d1ecf07117683abb8a74f501b221c32c7190fb2.png
Homura no Ohdachi | Sword, ★13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/7eca16080241dbffdd07e28a7e498b46ca27464f.png
Homura no Toshi | Assault Rifle, ★13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f1a40b2fe1926f6b15eeb6cd2605fba2888c0a19.png
Homura no Kashaku | Rod, ★13
 

NEW COLLECTION FOLDER
If you’re starting a bit behind your friends, the Collection Folder can be a great way to catch up. That’s why ARKS HQ is introducing a new Collection Folder–the Next ★13 Collection 1! These items are obtainable by completing Urgent Quests and Expeditions to collect the individual pieces needed for your desired reward. A few of the new ★13  items include:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ce08302ea4ad525bfc269ea32cb484e853be0ca0.png
Spear Revolsio | Partisan, ★13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/267314b8c802e36dae6be51aa869bbe91a43bd00.png
Bullet Revolsio | Twin Machine Guns, ★13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ef39873d06225170633951a220ab15838273f3fb.png
Edge Revolsio | Wand, ★13


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/eefea4e80380e22e2bab590c34fcfd19e7c46843.png
NEW STORY
Odd Arks seems to have infiltrated Fleet Oracle, but is their purpose nefarious? Discover their origin while you explore the newly-discovered planet, Earth, and learn of the parallels between your home and Earth. New characters and old friends will join you on your quest to curtail the Falspawn and other hostile entities. You’ll battle new enemies–Phantasms–the manifested fear and dread of Earth’s citizens, comprised of “Aether” particles and able to move as dust on the wind.


There’s more included, but we don’t want to spoil all the fun for you! Just make sure join us in Phantasy Star Online 2 on August 5th, when we welcome operatives from an additional 33 countries! See you on Earth, operatives!


 - The PSO2 Team

We are happy to announce a fantastic collaboration release to celebrate the launch of Phantasy Star Online 2 on Steam. Starting August 5th, ARKS Operatives will be able to get unique items based on Valve’s celebrated franchises!

[previewyoutube=L_S8ZDajTvg;full][/previewyoutube]

Embody HALF-LIFE 2’s Gordon Freeman or HALF-LIFE: ALYX’s Alyx Vance with special outfits and partner up with Wheatley from Portal 2 with a special Mag Evolution Device! This release will also include cosmetic items from Team Fortress 2 and Left 4 Dead, such as Hairstyles and Weapon Camos!

Update: This article has been updated to reflect changes to the in-game rewards requirements. Read the following list to learn more about how you can obtain these Valve-themed rewards.

Reward One: First-time Login Pack
Log-in to PSO2 on Steam and retrieve the reward from the Visiphone, under “Receive Campaign Items”.

Notes:

To be eligible to win the rewards, you must meet the requirements above while logged in to Steam.
Aside from the log-in rewards, you can collect the other prizes at the Gate Area’s TITLE COUNTER as a title reward.
Some Weapon Camos in this release are compatible with more than one weapon type.
You can use the Hairstyle items twice to make them accessible to all characters in your account.
The time and day for the distribution of these rewards will be revealed at a later date.



We are beyond excited to see you join the ranks of ARKS when Phantasy Star Online 2 finally releases on Steam. See you in the game on August 5th, operative!
